bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: A dwarf epiphytic or lithophytic plant to 4 cm. high. Pseudobulbs contiguous, ovoid, slightly compressed, up to 12 mm. long, 8 mm. in diameter, covered below with a few sheaths, 2-leaved above. Leaves divergent, linear, obtuse or shortly bilobed at the apex, to 3.5 cm. long, 3 mm. broad. Inflorescence unbranched, arising from leafless pseudobulbs, 3–3.5 cm. high, above the middle densely up to 15-flowered; peduncle covered with a few scarious sheaths; rhachis pubescent; bracts lanceolate, acuminate, 1.5 mm. long. Flowers non- resupinate, erect-spreading, white or pale rose, lip white with a central yellow stripe, densely pubescent outside; pedicellate ovary 3 mm. long, densely pubescent. Dorsal sepal erect, oblong-lanceolate, acute, 4–5 mm. long, 2 mm. broad; lateral sepals obliquely lanceolate-ovate, subacute, 4.5 mm. long, 2.5 mm. broad; mentum obtuse, obscure, 1.5–2 mm. high. Petals oblanceolate or oblong-oblanceolate, subacute, 4–5 mm. long, 2 mm. broad. Lip strongly recurved, elliptic to oblong, 4 mm. long, 2.5 mm. wide, subacute to apiculate, base rotund; disc densely farinaceous-papillose. Column short, fleshy, 1 mm. high. Fig. 78, p. 376.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: A ± pendulous epiphytic plant. Pseudobulbs ± caespitose or superposed, each pseudobulb arising from just below the middle of an older one, narrowly cylindrical- fusiform, up to 10 cm. long, 2–5 mm. wide, 2-leaved at apex, covered when young by 2 long cylindrical sheaths. Leaves grass-like, erect, linear, acutely minutely bilobed, 3–18 cm. long, 3–5 mm. wide, chartaceous in texture. Inflorescence suberect, racemose, 4–5.5 cm. long, subdensely many flowered, subtended by a compressed, paleaceous, acute sheath; bracts linear-lanceolate, acuminate, up to 2.5 mm. long. Flowers erect-spreading, glabrous, white or rose-white, lip tinged pink, column green; pedicel with ovary 2.5–3 mm. long. Dorsal sepal ovate or elliptic ovate, concave, obtuse or apiculate, 2–3 mm. long, 1.5–2.25 mm. wide; lateral sepals strongly obliquely ovate or oblong-ovate, apiculate, 2.25–3.25 mm. long, 1.7–2.25 mm. wide; mentum rounded, slightly curved, 1 mm. long. Petals obovate or elliptic-obovate, obtuse, 1.5–2.3 mm. long, 1.25–1.75 mm. wide. Lip long-clawed, hastate, 2.6–3.6 mm. long; claw oblong, 1–1.5 mm. long; lamina triangular or ovate-triangular, acute, 1.5–2 mm. long, 1.5–2 mm. wide, obtuse, with a lunate ridge-like callus above a central saccate depression. Column short, fleshy, 1–1.5 mm. long; rostellum porrect, obtuse at apex, shortly bidentate; foot strongly incurved, lightly channelled.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: A dwarf epiphytic or lithophytic plant to 4.5 cm. high. Pseudobulbs clustered, ovoid to conical, 0.8–2.7 cm. long, 0.7–1.1 cm. diameter, 3–4-leaved at apex. Leaves narrowly oblong-elliptic to elliptic, to 3.5 cm. long, 0.7–1.6 cm. wide, obtuse to rounded at apex, dark green above, purple below. Inflorescence 3–7.5 cm. high. 1–5-flowered; peduncle densely pubescent, terete; bracts lanceolate, 4 mm. long, 2 mm. wide, acuminate. Flowers large for size of plant, pubescent on outer surface; sepals cream, yellow-green or yellow-brown; lip white or pale green, side lobes veined purple, callus yellow; column white with purple spotting. Dorsal sepal ovate, 7.3–9.5 mm. long, to 4.5 mm. wide, acute; lateral sepals obliquely ovate-falcate, acuminate, 9.5 mm. long, 7 mm. wide. Petals oblanceolate, 7.5–8.5 mm. long, 2.8–3.2 mm. wide, obtuse. Lip shortly clawed, recurved, 3-lobed in the middle, 9.5–13 mm. long, 6.5–7 mm. wide; side lobes erect, subquadrate; mid-lobe much larger than side lobes, recurved, quadrate, 7 mm. long and wide, with a central thickened area and basally clavately hairy; disc and callus sparsely clavately pubescent. Column stout, 1.6 mm. long; column-foot tapering to base of lip, 8 mm. long, white with yellow-green at apex and purple spotting below.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: An erect epiphytic herb to 20 cm. tall. Pseudobulbs ovoid or conical, 1–3 cm. tall, 0.7–1 cm. diameter, clothed with white scarious cataphylls, 2–3-leaved at the apex. Leaves suberect, linear to oblanceolate, minutely apiculate, 6–11 cm. long, 0.9–1.2 cm. broad. Inflorescence erect, longer than the leaves, 7–13 cm. long, rather densely several-flowered towards the apex, densely pubescent; bracts ovate to lanceolate, acuminate, up to 9 mm. long. Flowers with red-purple sepals, a creamy lip yellow at the apex; callus yellow, spotted purple. Dorsal sepal ovate, acuminate, 9.5–11 mm. long, 4.8–5 mm. broad; lateral sepals ovate-triangular, acuminate, 10.5–12.5 mm. long, 6.7–8 mm. broad, forming a subconical mentum 5.5–6 mm. high. Petals oblanceolate, obtuse, 8–8.5 mm. long, 1.7–2.8 mm. broad. Lip reflexed near base, 3-lobed, sparsely clavate-pubescent, 7–8.5 mm. long, 5 mm. broad; side lobes somewhat obscure, subelliptic, running below the geniculation of the lip; mid-lobe ovate, subacute; callus absent or obscure. Column very short, 0.5 mm. long.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: An erect epiphytic herb 10–38 cm. high. Stems approximate, terete, with a basal nut-like swelling, up to 38 cm. high, 1–3 mm. in diameter, covered at the base by 1–2 scarious tubular sheaths, 3–5-leaved above. Leaves almost erect, linear or linear-ligulate, shortly obtuse or subacutely bidentate at apex, 4–17 cm. long, 2–6 mm. wide. Inflorescence subequal in length to the leaves, unbranched or weakly branched, to 17 cm. long, 4–many-flowered; peduncle to 12 cm. long, covered with papery sheaths; rhachis densely pubescent; bracts lanceolate or rarely ovate, long- acuminate, 1.5–7 mm. long; pedicel and ovary 5–7 mm. long, glabrous to pubescent. Flowers cream-coloured, fragrant, up-turned, drying yellow or brown. Dorsal sepal convex, lanceolate, acute, 8–10 mm. long, 2.5–3 mm. wide; lateral sepals subfalcate, triangular-lanceolate, acute, 10 mm. long, 4–5 mm. wide; mentum conical, 3.5–4.5 mm. high; sepals glabrous or very sparsely hairy. Petals curved, ligulate- oblanceolate, 7–9 mm. long, 1.7–2 mm. wide, acute or slightly acuminate. Lip shortly clawed, 3-lobed in middle, 3.5–9.5 mm. long, 6–6.5 mm. wide, recurved; side lobes semi-orbicular, rounded, 1 mm. long, 2 mm. wide; mid-lobe ovate-lanceolate to broadly oblong-lanceolate, 4 mm. long, 2.75 mm. wide, strongly recurved, acute or acuminate, margin crisped-undulate. Column slightly incurved, 2 mm. long, semi-terete. Fig. 79, p. 378.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: An erect to pendulous epiphytic herb to 28 cm. high. Pseudobulbs emitted from a stout terete short rhizome, compressed bilaterally, ancipitous, appressed to substrate, up to 4.5 cm. long, 1.7 cm. in diameter, 1-leafed, at the apex, subtended by 2–3 distichous, leaf-bearing cataphylls. Leaves narrowly oblong, suberect-spreading, rounded and unequally bilobed at the apex, up to 23 cm. long, 2.8 cm. broad, articulated to a conduplicate leaf- base. Inflorescence erect, simple or commonly 1–5-branched, pubescent, laxly to subdensely many-flowered; bracts narrowly lanceolate, long-acuminate, up to 15 mm. long, 2 mm. broad. Flowers very pubescent on outer surface, creamy-white with 2 orange marks on the lip. Dorsal sepal narrowly lanceolate, acuminate, 10–12 mm. long, 2–3.5 mm. broad; lateral sepals obliquely narrowly lanceolate, acuminate, 10–15 mm. long, 5 mm. broad, forming with the column-foot a rather rounded mentum 4 mm. high. Petals lanceolate to oblanceolate, acute, 8–9 mm. long, 1–1.5 mm. broad. Lip recurved in apical half, obscurely 3-lobed in middle, 9.5 mm. long, 4.5–6 mm. broad; side lobes subelliptic; mid-lobe narrowly triangular, acute, with a fleshy central callus; basal callus short, fleshy. Column fairly stout, terete, 2 mm. long.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: A medium-sized epiphytic herb to 15 cm. high. Pseudobulbs narrowly conical, to 3.5 cm. long, 0.9 cm. in diameter, glossy dark yellow-brown when dry, 2-leaved at the apex. Leaves narrowly elliptic or oblong-elliptic, 6–15.5 cm. long, 1.4 cm. wide, acute, obscurely bilobed at apex, glossy light green drying dark brown-black; petiole to articulation 1.5–2.5 cm. Inflorescence borne on new shoot ± before the pseudobulb develops, to 11 cm. long, 2–3-flowered; bracts small, setaceous, lanceolate, 2.5 mm. long, 1 mm. wide, acuminate. Flowers 2.5 cm. across, sweet-scented; sepals and petals white, lip with a pale yellow callus edged with crimson, side lobes with a crimson margin. Dorsal sepal ovate, apiculate, 13.5 mm. long, 7.1 mm. wide; lateral sepals obliquely ovate, acute, to 16 mm. long, 11.5 mm. wide, with a low keel on the outer surface. Petals obovate, subacute, 12.8 mm. long, 6.1 mm. wide. Lip 3-lobed, clavate-pubescent all over, 16.2 mm. long, 12 mm. wide; side lobes erect, oblong-falcate, truncate; mid-lobe oblong, recurved, obtuse, 7 mm. long, 6.5 mm. wide, with a fleshy thickening in the centre; disc with a basal narrow keel to middle. Fig. 86.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: A pendulous or erect epiphytic plant to 35 cm. or more long. Stems (or pseudobulbs) caespitose, terete, to 25 cm. long, 1 mm. wide, secondary and tertiary stems given off from apical half of older growths, 2–9 cm. long, 1 mm. wide, all covered in scarious tubular sheaths and leaf bases, 5–8-leaved in apical half. Leaves linear, grass-like, acute, flexuous, 5–11 cm. long, 2–3.5 mm. wide. Inflorescence unbranched, much shorter than the leaves, 4–8-flowered, 1.5–3 cm. long; bracts lanceolate, long- acuminate, 1.5–2.5 mm. long. Flowers suberect, white, greenish yellow or yellow, with a yellow or purple lip. Dorsal sepal ovate, acuminate, cucullate, 3–5 mm. long, 2 mm. wide; lateral sepals very obliquely ovate, acuminate, 6.8–9.5 mm. long (along longest margin), 4–5.5 mm. wide, forming with the column-foot a shortly and broadly cylindrical mentum 4–5.2 mm. long. Petals linear to oblong-elliptic, 2.7–3.5 mm. long, 0.8–1.1 mm. wide, acute. Lip with a long claw, obscurely 3-lobed in apical half, 6.5 mm. long, 4 mm. wide; side lobes erect, narrowly oblong, rounded at apex; mid-lobe much larger than side lobes, broadly ovate to orbicular, apiculate; claw pubescent; callus a fleshy transverse ridge between side lobes, sometimes sparsely pubescent. Column short, fleshy, subterete, truncate, 2 mm. long; foot slightly curved, 4 mm. long, long-pubescent within.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: An erect to pendent lithophytic plant to 1.2 mm. long. Stems clustered, pseudobulbous, conical, completely covered by persistent leaf-bases, 1.5–1.3 cm. long, 1.5–3 cm. in diameter at the base, from a short thick rhizome, 0.6–0.9 cm. in diameter, 4–8-leaved. Leaves distichous, arcuate, narrowly linear-lanceolate to oblanceolate, conduplicate, acute, 20–36 cm. long, 1.6–2.3 cm. wide, prominently many-nerved. Inflorescence much larger than the leaves, up to 92 cm. long, 1–3 branched at apex; peduncle covered by numerous imbricating acute sheaths; branches arcuate, fleshy, 2.5 mm. in diameter, up to 7 cm. long; bracts setose, 5–9 mm. long. Flowers large, pale pink. Dorsal sepal narrowly oblong-lanceolate, subacute, 19–21 mm. long, 5 mm. wide; lateral sepals obliquely and narrowly oblong-lanceolate, rounded to obtuse, 18–20 mm. long, 5.5–6.5 mm. wide; mentum 5 mm. high. Petals oblanceolate, subacute to obtuse, 16–19.5 mm. long, 3–4 mm. wide. Lip entire, shortly clawed, oblong-obovate, rounded or emarginate at the apex, 17–18 mm. long, 9.5–10 mm. wide; disc ± furfuraceous. Column white, semiterete, 5–6 mm. long.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: An epiphytic plant to 10 cm. high. Stems clustered, on a short ascending rhizome, pseudobulbous or obscurely pseudobulbous, with an obvious node in middle, conical or subpyriform, 1 cm. long, 0.45 cm. in diameter, about 4-leaved. Leaves suberect, distichous, spaced at 1 cm. intervals, obliquely angled, linear or slightly tapering towards apex, subacute or minutely unequally bilobed at apex, 6,3 cm. long, 0.85 cm. wide, articulated to an ancipitous sheathing base, 0.9–2.6 cm. long. Inflorescence erect, shorter than the leaves, ± 4-flowered, 4.5 cm. long; peduncle pubescent, subtended by an ancipitous acute sheath; bracts lanceolate, acuminate, 7 mm. long. Flowers pubescent on outer surface, with green tepals lined with red, lip whitish lined with red; pedicel and ovary densely pubescent. Dorsal sepal lanceolate, acute, 8 mm. long, 4 mm. wide; lateral sepals falcate-lanceolate, acute, 11 mm. long, 7 mm. wide, forming with the column-foot a broadly conical mentum 5 mm. high. Petals linear-lanceolate, slightly falcate, acute, 9 mm. long, 2 mm. wide. Lip shortly clawed, ecallose, papillose, 3-lobed just below the middle, 11 mm. long, 9 mm. wide; side lobes erect, falcately oblong, rounded at apex; mid-lobe subquadrate-orbicular, apiculate, margins undulate-erose. Column broad, 4.5 mm. long, white; stigma transversely oblong. Fig. 81.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: Dwarf epiphytic herb 3–7 cm. high. Pseudobulbs 4 mm. apart on a short stout creeping rhizome. Pseudobulbs erect or slightly curved, cylindrical-conical to ovoid- conical, 0.6–1.8 cm. long, 0.3–0.5 cm. diameter, 2–3-noded in apical half, drying yellow, 2–3-leaved. Leaves suberect, spreading above, conduplicate, subacute to obtuse, 3 cm. long, 0.4 cm. wide. Inflorescence erect, 2–5 cm., produced before the leaves have developed, racemose, 4–10-flowered; peduncle wiry, somewhat flattened, pubescent; bracts large, papery, cordate, mucronate, 6.5 mm. long, 8 mm. wide, sparsely pubescent. Flowers spreading, sparsely pubescent, colour unrecorded. Dorsal sepal lanceolate, acuminate, 7 mm. long, 2.8 mm. wide; lateral sepals obliquely lanceolate-falcate, acuminate, 8 mm. long, 4.5 mm. wide, forming with the column-foot a shortly conical mentum 4 mm. high. Petals oblong or oblanceolate, obtuse, 6.5 mm. long, 1.8 mm. wide. Lip very shortly clawed, recurved in middle, 3-lobed in basal half, 5.5 mm. long and 4 mm. wide when spread out; side lobes erect, subquadrate-rounded, clavate-pubescent; mid-lobe lanceolate, acuminate, fleshy, 4 mm. long, 1.8 mm. wide, bullate-rugulose, glabrous; callus fleshy, clavate-pubescent. Column short; anther hemispherical, verrucose at apex.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: A small epiphytic plant to 15 cm. high. Pseudobulbs erect or suberect, narrowly cylindric-conical, to 2.5 cm. long, 7–8 mm. in diameter, 2–3-leaved at the apex. Leaves erect-spreading, oblong-ligulate to oblanceolate or linear, obtuse to subacute, 4–12 cm. long, 5–17 mm. wide, glabrous. Inflorescence erect; peduncle minutely puberulous, 3.5–5.5 cm. long; bracts ovate, acuminate, minutely puberulous, as long as ovary, 7–14 mm. long. Flowers whitish with a yellow-brown hood, lime-green to yellowish brown; lip white, side lobes lined crimson. Dorsal sepal lanceolate-oblong, acuminate, 8–11.2 mm. long, 2–3 mm. wide; lateral sepals obliquely lanceolate, somewhat falcate, keeled on reverse, 9–13.5 mm. long, 5.5–7 mm. wide, acuminate; mentum shortly conical, 4.6 mm. high. Petals linear-oblanceolate, subacute, 6.5–7.5 mm. long, 0.5–1.5 mm. wide. Lip genuflex-recurved towards the middle, with a long claw, 3-lobed, 9 mm. long, 5 mm. wide, glabrous; side lobes erect, oblong, 2 mm. wide, 3.5 mm. long; mid-lobe oblong-lanceolate, fleshy, bullate, very recurved, acuminate, to 5.5 mm. long, 2 mm. wide; callus fleshy, ± papillose but not pubescent, lying between the side lobes. Column terete, 1 mm. long; column foot 4.5 mm. long, glabrous.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: A small epiphytic or lithophytic herb, 3.6–5.6 cm. high. Pseudobulbs loosely clustered, globose, shiny, slightly compressed, 0.8–1.6 cm. long, 8–13 mm. in diameter, lacking basal sheath. Leaf spreading, elliptic-ovate, obtuse, auriculate at the base, 2.2–4 cm. long, 1.3–1.8 cm. broad, coriaceous, articulated 4.5 mm. above the apex of the pseudobulb. Inflorescence arcuate or pendent, longer than the leaf, a 1–2-branched raceme, to 5 cm. long, up to 8-flowered or more; peduncle slender, up to 3.5 cm. long; basal sheath membranaceous; bracts ovate-triangular, apiculate, amplexicaul, 1.5–3 mm. long. Flowers yellow tinged with rose-purple. Dorsal sepal elliptic- triangular, apiculate, 5.4–6.8 mm. long, 2–2.2 mm. broad; lateral sepals obliquely triangular, 6–7 mm. long, 4–5 mm. broad; mentum ovoid, 5.5–6.5 mm. high. Petals obovate-lanceolate, acute, 4.5–5 mm. long, 1.4–1.8 mm. broad. Lip weakly recurved, shortly clawed, indistinctly 3-lobed, 5–6 mm. long, 4–4.5 mm. broad; side lobes elliptic, rounded; mid-lobe broadly triangular, 1–1.4 mm. long, 1.5–2 mm. broad; callus obscurely fleshy; disc pubescent. Column 1–1.5 mm. long; foot 3–3.7 mm. long; pollinia subglobose.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: A dwarf epiphytic plant to 4.5 cm. high. Pseudobulbs borne 1 cm. apart on a creeping rhizome, conical above, ± prostrate, with apex upcurved, 0.6–1.3 cm. long, 0.6 cm. wide, 2-leaved at apex. Leaves ligulate to oblong-elliptic, spreading, acute, 2–4.2 cm. long, 0.3–1.2 cm. wide. Inflorescence erect, to 3.2 cm. high, 1 (–2)-flowered; peduncle sparsely pubescent; bracts ovate, acute, 2.5 mm. long, 2 mm. wide. Flowers large for size of plant, sepals pink or white with a mauve margin. Dorsal sepal narrowly ovate, acute, 10–15.5 mm. long, 5.7–6 mm. wide; lateral sepals obliquely ovate, acute, 11–17 mm. long, 7–9 mm. wide; mentum 6.5 mm. long. Petals oblanceolate to subspathulate, rounded at apex. 10–14 mm. long, 4–4.7 mm. wide. Lip 3-lobed in middle, 10–15 mm. long, 10–12 mm. wide; side lobes rounded, shorter than mid-lobe; mid-lobe triangular, acute, 6 mm. long and wide, disc pubescent; callus fleshy, raised over base of lip; ± 3-lobed at front. Column long, winged on each side, 5 mm. long; column-foot 5 mm. long.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: An epiphytic herb often growing in large clumps. Pseudobulbs oblong, bilaterally compressed, ± 3.2 cm. long, 2 cm. in diameter, green, one-leafed at apex. Leaf erect, narrowly oblong-elliptic, rounded at apex, ± 15 cm. long, 3 cm. broad. Inflorescence shorter than the leaf, ± 10 cm. long, up to 8-flowered, peduncle bilaterally compressed, 7.5 cm. long, with a 3.3 cm. basal sheath which quickly turns black with age; bracts conduplicate, cordate, acuminate, 7 mm. long, 8 mm. broad. Flowers waxy, scented of propolis, white with a purple margin to the lip, a pale yellow callus and a pink anther-cap. Dorsal sepal ovate-elliptic, acuminate, 1.2 cm. long, 0.7 cm. broad; lateral sepals obliquely triangular, acuminate, 1.5 cm. long, 1 cm. broad, with a median keel 4 mm. broad on the outer surface; mentum bilobed at apex, conical, 8 mm. long. Petal oblong-elliptic, acute, 1.1 cm. long, 0.45 cm. broad. Lip recurved, obscurely 3-lobed, 1.1 cm. long, 0.9 cm. broad; callus obscure, of 2 narrow ridges on to mid-lobe. Column 4 mm. long; foot purplish streaked.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: An epiphytic herb, 17–36 cm. high. Pseudobulbs from a short creeping rhizome clustered, narrowly obclavate, ridged, 7.5–16.3 mm. long, 0.3–0.7 mm. broad, clothed in 4–6 basal sheaths. Leaf ligulate, obtuse, subcordate at the base, 11.5–23.4 cm. long, 1.6–3.2 cm. broad, coriaceous, articulated 1–2 mm. above the apex of the pseudobulb. Inflorescence longer than the leaf, paniculate, 11–28 cm. long, up to 40-flowered; peduncle stout, 7.5–20 cm. long; basal sheath membranaceous, to 3.5 cm. long; bracts ovate-triangular, acuminate, amplexicaul, 2.5–4 mm. long. Flowers yellow-green; lip white with some basal red spotting. Dorsal sepal ovate- elliptic, acute to acuminate, 6–7.3 mm. long, 2–3 mm. broad; lateral sepals spreading, triangular-lanceolate, subfalcate, 7–8.5 mm. long, 4.5–5.2 mm. broad; mentum conical, 6–8 mm. long. Petals linear to obovate-spathulate, subacute, 5–5.7 mm. long, 1–1.8 mm. broad. Lip strongly recurved, distinctly 3-lobed, 7–8 mm. long, 5–5.6 mm. broad; side lobes erect, triangular to ovate, shorter than mid-lobe; mid-lobe subquadrate-oblong, sparsely pubescent, apiculate, 3.5–4 mm. long, 2.2–2.9 mm. broad; callus a fleshy ridge between the side lobes. Column subterete, 1.5–2 mm. long; foot 4–5 mm. long; pollinia hemispherical. Fig. 72.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: An epiphytic herb, 6.4–16 cm. high. Pseudobulbs tightly clustered, from a short creeping rhizome, narrowly cylindric, 1.5–6.5 cm. long, 1–2 mm. in diameter, clothed in 2–3 membranous basal sheaths. Leaf linear, cuneate below, subacute to obtuse, 5–11 cm. long, 3–7 mm. broad, coriaceous, articulated, 0.5–1 mm. above the pseudobulb apex. Inflorescence shorter than the leaf, simply racemose, 0.8–4 cm. long, up to 4-flowered; peduncle slender, 0.4–2.3 cm. long, with a membranous basal sheath; bracts ovate-triangular, amplexicaul, acuminate, 3–6 mm. long. Flowers pale green or dull yellow, marked with red. Dorsal sepal triangular-ovate, shortly apiculate, 6.5–7 mm. long, 2.5–3.5 mm. broad; lateral sepals obliquely trangular, bluntly apiculate, 6–10 mm. long, 6–7 mm. broad; mentum ovoid-conical, curved, 6 mm. long. Petals narrowly elliptic to obovate-lanceolate, subacute, 5.7–8 mm. long, 1.5 mm. broad. Lip strongly recurved, sessile, obscurely to distinctly 3-lobed, with basal half ecallose, 6–8 mm. long, 4.5–6 mm. broad; side lobes erect, semi-elliptic; mid-lobe subquadrate-oblong, obtuse. Column subterete, 1.5–2.3 mm. long; foot 4.5–6 mm. long; pollinia ovoid.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: An erect epiphytic plant, 25–60 cm. long. Stems obscurely pseudobulbous, conical- cylindrical, 1.5–2.5 cm. long, 0.5–1 cm. diameter, 4–6-leaved. Leaves suberect, oblanceolate, ligulate or linear-lanceolate, acute or rounded at apex, 13–33 cm. long, 1.2–3 cm. wide, veins prominent on underside. Inflorescence much longer than the leaves, paniculate, 18–45 cm. long; peduncle and rhachis more or less covered with scarious sheathing bracts; branches secund, to 3.5 cm. long, many-flowered; bracts lanceolate, recurved, acuminate, 4.5 mm. long. Flowers brownish green more or less marked with purple, lip pale greenish yellow. Dorsal sepal oblong-ovate, acute, 4–5 mm. long, 1.8–2.4 mm. wide; lateral sepals oblong-ovate, acuminate, 5.5–8 mm. long, 5.3–7.5 mm. wide, forming with the column-foot a cylindrical-conical mentum 5–7.5 mm. high. Petals linear to oblanceolate, acute, 3.5–4.5 mm. long, 0.5–0.75 mm. wide. Lip clawed, 3-lobed at apex, 5.4–7 mm. long, 4.3–5 mm. wide; side lobes erect, pointing forwards, oblong, rounded at apex, ± longer than the mid-lobe; mid-lobe broadly oblong, apiculate, margins undulate-crenulate, 1.3–1.4 mm. long, 2.2–2.6 mm. wide, with a central longitudinal crenate ridge; callus fleshy, 3.5–4 mm. long, dilated and rounded at apex. Column tapering to apex, 1.5 mm. long.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: An epiphytic or rarely terrestrial herb, 12–31 cm. high. Pseudobulbs loosely clustered, from a creeping rhizome, cylindric, 4.5–10 cm. long, 1.5–5 mm. in diameter articulated in basal half, clothed in 3–4 membranaceous sheaths. Leaf ovate to lanceolate, obtuse, cuneate at base, 11.5–21 cm. long, 1.6–2.4 cm. broad, coriaceous, articulated 1–2 mm. above the pseudobulb apex. Inflorescence mostly shorter than the leaf, pubescent, a simple or rarely once branched raceme, 3–18 cm. long, up to 8 flowers borne successively; peduncle stout, 1.2–7.8 cm. long, with a membranous basal sheath; bracts ovate-triangular, acuminate, amplexicaul, 3–7 mm. long. Flowers off-white, greenish yellow or yellow, mottled or streaked purple. Dorsal sepal triangular-ovate, apiculate, 5–10 mm. long, 2.2–4 mm. broad; lateral sepals spreading, obliquely triangular, apiculate, 6.5–10 mm. long and broad; all sepals pubescent on outer surfaces; mentum conical, 6–9 mm. long. Petals obliquely obovate-lanceolate, obtuse, 4–7 mm. long, 1.2–2 mm. broad. Lip strongly recurved in the middle, ± clawed, distinctly 3-lobed, 6.5–10 mm. long, 3.5–5.5 mm. broad; side lobes ± porrect, triangular-ovate; mid-lobe ovate-quadrate to oblong, fleshy, truncate or rounded and apiculate at the apex, 2.4–4.5 mm. long, 2.5–4.3 mm. broad, glandular-pubescent in the centre; callus ± central. Column subterete, 1–2 mm. long; foot 5–8 mm. long; pollinia subquadrate-globose.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: An erect epiphytic (or rarely lithophytic) plant 20–42 cm. long. Pseudobulbs subglobose to narrowly conical, enclosed by leaf-bases at first, 2–4.5 cm. long, 0.6–1.5 cm. diameter, 4–8-leaved. Leaves oblanceolate to narrowly oblong- elliptic, rounded to subacute and minutely unequally bilobed at the apex, 13–26 cm. long, 2.8–4.2 cm. wide, veins prominent on lower surface. Inflorescence erect, paniculate, equal to or longer than the leaves, 10–30 cm. long; peduncle to 15 cm. long, covered by 1–3 scarious sheaths; branches 6–15, spreading, puberulous, many-flowered, to 6.5 cm. long; bracts ovate-lanceolate, acuminate, 3–4 mm. long, 2 mm. wide. Flowers ± downy-pubescent on outer surface, fragrant, white, dull red-brown or pale green, flushed or striped red or purple on sepals; lip white, mid-lobe ± pink marked; callus yellow towards apex. Dorsal sepal ovate, acuminate, 5 mm. long, 2.5–3 mm. wide; lateral sepals obliquely ovate, apiculate, 8.2–8.5 mm. long, 4–5.6 mm. wide, forming with the column-foot a conical mentum 4–5.4 mm. high. Petals obliquely spathulate or oblanceolate, rounded, obtuse or minutely apiculate at apex, 4.6–5 mm. long, 1–1.5 mm. wide. Lip recurved, 3-lobed at or above the middle, 7–8 mm. long, 5–7.5 mm. wide; side lobes erect, incurved, falcately oblong, subacute, 4 mm. long, 2.5 mm. wide; mid-lobe suborbicular, emarginate, margins crenulate, 2.7 mm. long, 3.7 mm. wide; callus an elliptic thickening, lying between the side lobes, 2 mm. long, 1 mm. wide. Column 2–2.5 mm. long. Fig. 75.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: An epiphytic herb 4.5–28.5 cm. high. Pseudobulbs from a short creeping rhizome, loosely clustered, narrowly cylindric, 1.5–15.4 cm. long, 2.1–2.5 mm. in diameter, clothed in 2–3 membranous basal sheaths. Leaf elliptic to ovate, obtuse, auriculate at the base, coriaceous, 3–13 cm. long, 1–3.3 cm. broad, articulated 2 mm. above the apex of the pseudobulb. Inflorescence longer than the leaf, a 2–8 branched panicle, 6–17.5 cm. long, up to 60-flowered; peduncle slender to stout, up to 7.5 cm. long, ± sparsely pubescent, basal sheath membranous; bracts triangular-ovate, apiculate, amplexicaul, 1–2.5 mm. long. Flowers yellow or greenish yellow, spotted with magenta. Dorsal sepal oblong-lanceolate, apiculate, 4–5.4 mm. long, 2–2.5 mm. broad concave; lateral sepals obliquely triangular, 4–7.3 mm. long, 3.5–6 mm. broad; mentum ovoid, to 6 mm. high. Petals linear to spathulate, obtuse, 3.5–6 mm. long, 1.2–1.5 mm. broad. Lip very fleshy, sessile, distinctly 3-lobed, 4.4–7 mm. long, 2–6.5 mm. broad; side lobes erect, rounded below, triangular and acute above, fleshy; mid-lobe fleshy, linear, truncate, shortly apiculate behind, 2–2.8 mm. long, 0.9–1.5 mm. broad. Column subterete, 1–2.3 mm. long; foot 2.9–4 mm. long; pollinia subglobose.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: An erect epiphytic plant, 22–40 cm. long. Pseudobulbs cylindrical, clustered, strongly compressed, 3–4-noded, grooved when old, 5–18 cm. long, 13–22 mm. diameter, 3–4-leaved. Leaves distichous, ligulate, suberect-spreading, narrowed to the more or less unequally bilobed apex, 10–30 cm. long, 2–3.4 cm. wide. Inflorescence generally longer than the leaves, a many-branched raceme, many-flowered, to 21 cm. long, subtended by 1–3 obtuse to acute, ancipitous sheaths; peduncle glabrous, 5–13 cm. long, ± covered by the basal sheaths; rhachis terete, glabrous; branches suberect, slightly incurved, to 6 cm. long, many-flowered. Flowers small, flame-red or orange with red markings on the lip. Dorsal sepal lanceolate, acute, 3 mm. long, 0.8 mm. wide; lateral sepals obliquely lanceolate, acute, 3.7 mm. long, 1.8 mm. wide, forming with the column-foot an obscurely conical mentum 1.3 mm. long. Petals oblanceolate, subacute, 2.7–2.8 mm. long, 0.5 mm. wide. Lip ovate to elliptic, entire, acute, 2.8 mm. long, 1.7 mm. wide, disc with a callus, concave in front. Column semiterete, truncate, 1 mm. long.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: A medium-sized epiphytic herb to 22 cm. tall with a short creeping rhizome. Pseudobulbs approximate, somewhat oblique, narrowly conical to subcylindric, 3–4 cm. long, 0.4–0.8 cm. in diameter, 2-leaved at apex. Leaves conduplicate, narrowly oblanceolate, subacute, 12–18.5 cm. long, 1–1.8 cm. in diameter, drying dark brown, articulate at base to a conduplicate sheath 1–1.5 cm. long. Inflorescence erect, 8–13 cm. long, 5–8-flowered; peduncle compressed, up to 8 cm. long, pubescent, with a lanceolate acuminate sterile bract towards the middle; rhachis pubescent; bracts falcate in side view, ovate-elliptic, acuminate, 6–9 mm. long, with erose margins. Flowers very fleshy, sparsely pubescent on outer surface, creamy with a green flush towards the base of the sepals; lip white flushed pink on the margins; ovary and pedicel 0.8–1.1 cm. long, pubescent. Dorsal sepal elliptic, subacute, 10 mm. long, 5 mm. broad; lateral sepals obliquely ovate-triangular, acute, 11–12 mm. long, 7 mm. broad, forming with the column-foot a subconical mentum 4.5–5 mm. high. Petals narrowly elliptic, obtuse, 7–8.5 mm. long, 2–2.5 mm. broad. Lip strongly recurved at base of mid-lobe, 3-lobed, ± 8 mm. long, 5 mm. broad, but difficult to flatten, pubescent in basal half; side lobes erect, rounded; mid-lobe ovate, acute; callus between side lobes fleshy, pubescent or papillose. Column 1.5 mm. long; pollinia 4 of two sizes; stips subquadrate, short; viscidium elliptic.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: An epiphytic herb, 20–30.5 cm. high. Pseudobulbs tightly clustered, from a short creeping rhizome, narrowly cylindric, 8–18.5 cm. long, 1.5–4.5 cm. broad, clothed in 2–3 membranous sheaths. Leaf linear, acute, cuneate at base, 12–22 cm. long, 7–14 mm. broad, coriaceous, articulated ± 1 mm. above the pseudobulb apex. Inflorescence mostly longer than the leaf, a 1–6-branched raceme, 7.9–19 cm. long, up to 20 flowers opening successively; peduncle slender, 5.6–11.7 cm. long, with a membranous basal sheath; bracts triangular-ovate, apiculate, amplexicaul, 2–3 mm. long. Flowers dull white, yellow, pale green or yellowish green, often spotted or marked purple. Dorsal sepal triangular-ovate, 6–8.5 mm. long, 2–3.5 mm. broad; Lateral sepals spreading, oblique, rounded-triangular, 6–8.5 mm. long, 3.7–5.2 mm. broad; mentum conical, up to 5 mm. long. Petals narrowly elliptic or spathulate, obtuse, 4.5–8 mm. long, 1.5–2.5 mm. broad. Lip strongly recurved, more or less sessile, oblong, entire or obscurely 3-lobed, rounded, truncate or apiculate at the apex, ± glandular-pubescent towards base, 5–6.5 mm. long, 3–5 mm. broad; side lobes erect, elliptic; mid-lobe rounded-subquadrate, shortly apiculate, 2.3 mm. long, 3 mm. broad; callus absent or obscurely fleshy. Column 1.5–2.7 mm. long; foot 4–6 mm. long; pollinia ovoid.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: An erect epiphytic plant 14–45 cm. high. Pseudobulbs erect, narrowly conical, 8–10 cm. high, 0.9 cm. wide, 3–4-leaved. Leaves drying dark brown or black, suberect, ligulate, 12–18 cm. long, 0.8–2.2 cm. long, unequally roundly bilobed at apex. Inflorescence erect, up to 26 cm. long, subtended by a long compressed sheath, cylindrical, densely many-flowered; bracts setaceous, 3–8 mm. long, acuminate. Flowers minute, yellow, yellow-green or cream-coloured. Dorsal sepal ovate-triangular, acuminate, 2.3 mm. long, 1.2 mm. wide; lateral sepals ovate, triangular, 2.9 mm. long, 2.25 mm. wide, acuminate. Petals oblong or narrowly elliptic, 1.6 mm. long, 0.7 mm. wide, acute or acuminate. Lip shortly clawed, ecallose, 3-lobed in basal half, 2.2 mm. long and wide; side lobes at right-angles to mid-lobe or slightly curved back, triangular or oblong; mid-lobe subquadrate or oblong, 1.2 mm. long, 1 mm. wide, apiculate. Column short, fleshy, 0.8 mm. long; rostellum porrect, 2-lobed, lobes acute.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: An epiphytic herb, 22–34 cm. high. Pseudobulbs from a short rhizome, tightly clustered, narrowly ovoid-conical, slightly compressed, 2.5–5 cm. long, 1.3–2 cm. in diameter, clothed in 3–5 basal sheaths. Leaf lanceolate to oblanceolate, acute, cuneate below, coriaceous, 22–29 cm. long, 2.5–3.2 cm. broad, articulated 2–3.5 cm. above the pseudobulb apex. Inflorescence shorter than the leaf, racemose, 12–20 cm. long, up to 6 flowers borne successively; peduncle stout, 12–16 cm. long; basal sheath membranaceous; bracts spreading, ovate-triangular, acuminate, 8–10 mm. long. Flowers cream with a mauve-purple lip and yellow callus. Dorsal sepal oblong- ovate, apiculate, 25 mm. long, 8–9 mm. broad; lateral sepals obliquely triangular, falcate, 25 mm. long, 11–18 mm. broad; mentum broadly conical, rounded, 10–17 mm. high. Petals spreading, elliptic-spathulate, acute, 20 mm. long, 7–9 mm. broad. Lip strongly recurved in the middle, oblong, 3-lobed in the middle, 30 mm. long, 18 mm. broad, long-pubescent at the base; side lobes elliptic-ovate, papillose; mid-lobe oblong- triangular, shortly apiculate, 15 mm. long, 10 mm. broad; callus fleshy in basal half, obscurely 3-lobed in front. Column subterete, winged, 5 mm. long; foot 15 mm. long, pubescent below; pollinia subquadrate-globose.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: A small epiphytic herb to 8 cm. high. Pseudobulbs contiguous, narrow at the base, ovoid or ellipsoid above, 1–2 cm. long, 0.5–1 cm. wide, covered with membranous sheaths, 2–3-leaved at the apex. Leaves narrowly oblong or oblong-elliptic, 1.5–5 cm. long, 5–10 mm. wide above the articulation, apex shortly bilobulate. Inflorescence erect, racemose, to 7 cm. high; peduncle to 4.5 cm. long; raceme 1–3 cm. long, laxly 3–5-flowered; bracts ovate, acuminate, subscarious, to 4 mm. long, much shorter than the flowers. Flowers cream, deflexed, pubescent on the outside; pedicel very short; ovary 2–4 mm. long, densely covered with white hairs. Dorsal sepal elliptic- lanceolate, shortly acuminate, 7 mm. long, 3 mm. wide; lateral sepals obliquely oblong-lanceolate, subacute, 8.5–11 mm. long, 3 mm. wide. Petals slightly curved, oblong- lanceolate, acute, 6 mm. long, 1.5 mm. wide, glabrous. Lip with a long ligulate claw, subhastate, 3-lobed, 11 mm. long, 4 mm. wide; side lobes short, obtuse; mid-lobe acute, 4 mm. long, 3 mm. wide, with the pulvinus almost covered with articulated yellow hairs; claw and disc sparsely covered with hairs. Column short, almost terete, scarcely 2 mm. long; stigmatic cavity transversely elliptic. Fig. 84.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: A dwarf epiphytic plant to 7 cm. high. Pseudobulbs clustered, ovoid or subspherical, 12 mm. long, 9 mm. diameter, 2(–3)-leaved at apex. Leaves ligulate, recurved, conduplicate when young, developing after flowers, 3.5 cm. long, 5 mm. wide, obtuse, articulated 3 mm. above apex of pseudobulb. Inflorescence erect, to 4.5 cm. high, 2–3-flowered; peduncle terete, wiry, 1.7 cm. long, glabrous; bracts broadly ovate, apiculate, 2 mm. long and wide. Flowers 14 mm. across, erect, yellow; pedicel and ovary slender, erect, glabrous, 9 mm. long. Dorsal sepal oblong-ovate, 6.4 mm. long, 3.4 mm. wide, acute; lateral sepals broadly obliquely triangular, shortly apiculate, 8 mm. long, 6 mm. wide. Petals obovate-oblong, 6 mm. long, 2.8 mm. wide, obtuse. Lip shortly clawed, 3-lobed in the middle, 7–9.5 mm. long, 6–7 mm. wide, papillose-hairy in basal two-thirds, with a small longitudinal fleshy callus between the side lobes; side lobes obliquely oblong, 3 mm. long, 2.5 mm. wide; mid-lobe spreading, rotund to oblong, 4.5 mm. long and wide, margin hyaline, centre fleshy, rugulose, very shortly apiculate behind. Column short, 2 mm. long; column-foot slender, forming with the lateral sepals a mentum 6 mm. long.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: A suberect or pendent plant to 20 cm. long. Stems clustered at base, branched above or superposed, terete, flexuose, slender, 1.6–11 cm. long, 1–1.2 mm. diameter, 2–4-leaved in apical half. Leaves linear, soft in texture, light green, minutely roundly bilobed at apex, 1.5–5 cm. long, 1.5–3 mm. wide. Inflorescence 0.8–2 cm. long, 1–4-flowered; bracts ovate-lanceolate, long-acuminate, 2.5–3 cm. long. Flowers fairly showy, pale pink and white with a crimson column, diurnally scented. Dorsal sepal ovate-elliptic, acuminate to apiculate, 6.2 mm. long, 3.3 mm. wide; lateral sepals obliquely ovate, acuminate or apiculate, 10.6 mm. long on longest margin, 5.7–6 mm. wide, forming with the column-foot a cylindrical-conical mentum to 5.7 mm. high. Petals elliptic, shortly clawed, obtuse or rounded at the apex, 4.25 mm. long, 2 mm. wide. Lip with a long claw, 3-lobed in the middle, 7.5–8.2 mm. long, 4.5–5.4 mm. wide; side lobes auriculate, subacute, 0.5 cm. long; mid-lobe suborbicular, margins erose, apiculate, 3.4 mm. long, 4.4 mm. wide; callus between side lobes fleshy, porrect, 2–3-toothed at front. Column truncate, 1 mm. long. Fig. 77, p. 374.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: An epiphytic plant 8–30 cm. high, glabrous. Pseudobulbs obscure, ovoid, 5 mm. long, 3 mm. wide, each shoot 2–3-leaved. Leaves spreading, elliptic, oblanceolate or oblong -oblanceolate, subacute to obtuse at apex, articulated on petiole 1–3 cm. above the base, 5.5–16 cm. long, 1.5–2.6 cm. wide. Inflorescence erect, paniculate, produced with or after the leaves, 5–27 cm. long, subtended to lowest branch by 1–3 compressed acute sheaths; branches suberect, densely many-flowered; bracts minute, lanceolate, acuminate, 1.5 mm. long. Flowers very small, pale yellow, orange or greenish yellow, lip pale pink, anther purple. Dorsal sepal ovate, shortly acuminate, 1.8–2 mm. long, 0.9–1.1 mm. wide; lateral sepals obliquely ovate-triangular, to 3.5 mm. long, 2.5 mm. wide, acute; mentum helmet-shaped, 2.2–2.5 mm. long. Petals oblong- oblanceolate, 1.2 mm. long, 0.3–0.4 mm. wide, subacute or obtuse. Lip long-clawed, 3- lobed in apical half, 2.7 mm. long, 1.7 mm. wide; side lobes oblong-ovate, spreading forwards, a little smaller than the mid-lobe; mid-lobe ovate-elliptic, rounded or subacute, 0.8 mm. long, 0.6 mm. wide.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: An epiphytic herb up to 26 cm. long. Stems arising from a creeping rhizome, approximate, erect, pseudobulbous at the base, 3–4-leaved above, 5–6 cm. long; pseudobulbs ovoid or conical-ovoid, 5–7 mm. long, 4–5 mm. diameter. Leaves erect, linear, obtuse, shortly and unequally bilobed at the apex, 9–21 cm. long, 3–5 mm. wide. Inflorescence very much shorter than the leaves, 5–7 cm. long, few-flowered above; peduncle 3–5 cm. long, covered with 2–3 linear acute imbricating sheaths; rhachis slightly flexuose, shortly pubescent; bracts ovate, shortly or markedly acuminate, 1.5–2 mm. long. Flowers ± spreading, glabrous, fragrant; sepals and petals white with pinkish mauve margins, lip white with a lime-green disc. Dorsal sepal lanceolate, shortly acuminate, 9.5–11.5 mm. long, 3.75–4.5 mm. wide; lateral sepals obliquely triangular, acuminate, 12.5–13.5 mm. long, 7–9 mm. wide; mentum incurved, rotund-conical, 6.5–7.5 mm. long, bilobed at apex. Petals narrowly lanceolate, acuminate, 10–10.5 mm. long, 3 mm. wide. Lip recurved slightly, shortly clawed, 3-lobed just below the middle, 12 mm. long, 9.5–11 mm. wide; side lobes erect, semiovate, rounded at apex; mid-lobe clawed, recurved, suborbicular above, 6–7 mm. long, 5.5–8.5 mm. wide, margin slightly undulate, rugulose, 2–3-keeled in middle, keels crenulate; disc with a longitudinal callus to the base of the mid-lobe. Column 4 mm. long, semiterete.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: An epiphytic plant to 31 cm. long. Stems clustered, pendulous, pseudobulbous at the base, slender and terete above, 3 cm. long, 1 mm. wide; pseudobulbs narrowly conical, 1.3 cm. long, 5 mm. wide at base. Leaves 3, narrowly linear, flexuose, acute, 8–30 cm. long, 2–2.5 mm. wide, articulated 2 cm. above the base. Inflorescence much shorter than the leaves, racemose, few-flowered, pendulous, with an upcurved apex, 7 cm. long; peduncle terete, 3.5 cm. long, pubescent; rhachis curved, terete, densely pubescent; bracts lanceolate, acuminate, 2–4 mm. long. Flowers spreading, ochreous with a well-defined red-brown central nerve, black when dry. Dorsal sepal lanceolate, acute, 8.7 mm. long, 2.8 mm. wide; lateral sepals obliquely narrowly triangular-lanceolate, 11.7 mm. long, 4.8 mm. wide, forming with the column-foot a broadly conical mentum 4 mm. high. Petals oblanceolate, acuminate, 8 mm. long, 1.9 mm. wide. Lip shortly clawed, recurved, obscurely 3-lobed in the middle, somewhat rhombic in outline, 7.6 mm. long, 5.7 mm. wide; side lobes erect, very narrowly oblong, obtuse; mid-lobe triangular, acute, 3.7 mm. long, 4.2 mm. wide at base, clavately pubescent; disc with an obscure fleshy keel to one-third the length of the lip, glabrous. Fig. 82.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: A pendulous epiphytic plant to 50 cm. or more long. Stems (or pseudobulbs) cylindrical or narrowly fusiform, 3–20 cm. long, 3–9 mm. wide, yellow or purple, superposed, given off from the middle of the previous growth. Leaves spreading, somewhat undulate, elliptic, oblong or oblanceolate, 5–15 cm. long, 1.5 cm. wide, acute or subacute, nerves prominent. Inflorescence 3.5–9 cm. long, pubescent, branching or unbranched, shorter than the terminal leaves; bracts narrowly lanceolate, acuminate, 0.4–0.7 cm. long. Flowers green or yellowish green, tinged with brown or mauve, lip yellow marked with purple. Dorsal sepal ovate-lanceolate, acute or acuminate, 4.8 mm. long, 2 mm. wide; lateral sepals obliquely ovate-triangular, acuminate, 5.5 mm. long, 3 mm. wide, forming with the column-foot a mentum 2.6 mm. long. Petals linear or lanceolate, acute, 3.8 mm. long, 1 mm. wide. Lip shortly clawed, 3-lobed above or at the middle, 5 mm. long, 3.8 mm. wide, ecallose or with a slight fleshy thickening between the side lobes; side lobes erect, elliptic, rounded; mid-lobe ovate or rotund, acuminate or apiculate, 2.3 mm. long, 2.2 mm. wide. Column terete, 1.2 mm. long.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: An erect or pendulous epiphytic plant to ± 25 cm. long. Stems slender, narrowly cylindrical, 1.5–11 cm. long, 1.5 mm. wide, superposed, emitted from along length of old growth, covered by a number of scarious sheaths when young, 2-leaved towards apex. Leaves suberect, narrowly oblong-elliptic to linear, acute or rounded and unequally bilobed at apex, 3–7 cm. long, 2.5–6 mm. wide. Inflorescence unbranched, shorter than the leaves, 1–5 cm. long, 2–8-flowered; bracts ovate to lanceolate, acuminate, 1.5–3 mm. long. Flowers cream to yellow-green, sometimes tinged pink. Dorsal sepal concave, ovate-lanceolate, acuminate, 4.5 mm. long, 2 mm. wide; lateral sepals very obliquely ovate, 5 mm. long, 5.5 mm. wide, shortly acuminate, forming with the column-foot a long cylindrical mentum 5 mm. long, slightly wider towards the apex. Petals oblanceolate, acute, 4.5 mm. long, 1 mm. wide. Lip long-clawed, 3-lobed in apical half, 7.5–9 mm. long, 5.5 mm. wide; side lobes rounded-elliptic, overlapping mid-lobe margins; mid-lobe rotund-quadrate, ± apiculate, ± pubescent; callus between the side lobes somewhat obscurely fleshy. Column slightly dilated above, terete, 2.5 mm. long.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: An erect epiphytic or rarely terrestrial plant, to 50 cm. long. Stems clustered, terete, 7–32 cm. long, 1–4 mm. diameter, covered at the base by 2–3 acute sheaths, 4–7(–12)-leaved in apical two-thirds. Leaves suberect, linear or linear- lanceolate, unequally and acutely bilobed at the apex, to 22 cm. long, 2–11 mm. wide. Inflorescence terminal, paniculate, 10–20 cm. long; peduncle 5–10 cm. long, subtended by 1–3 imbricating paleaceous sheaths; branches 1–5, spreading, often simple but rarely branched again, to 9 cm. long, 1 cm. wide including the flowers, densely many-flowered; rhachis slender, terete; bracts minute, triangular, acuminate, 1.5 mm. long. Flowers erect-spreading or suberect, almost globose, white or yellow-green, with a purple margin, glabrous. Dorsal sepal erect or slightly curved, concave, broadly elliptic-ovate, obtuse, 1.7–2.5 mm. long, 1.5–2 mm. wide; lateral sepals obliquely rotund-triangular, acute or shortly apiculate, 2.2–3.4 mm. long, 2.4–2.6 mm. wide; mentum globose, 2.1–2.4 mm. high. Petals elliptic or subspathulate-ligulate, obtuse or rounded, 1.4–2.2 mm. long, 0.6–0.8 mm. wide. Lip shortly clawed, ecallose, 3- lobed above the middle, 2.4–2.8 mm. long, 2.5–3.3 mm. wide; side lobes erect, curved forwards, ligulate-lanceolate; mid-lobe about equal in length to side lobes, rotund- triangular or semi-ovate, obtuse, apex recurved, 0.8–1 mm. long, 1–1.2 mm. wide. Column short, almost terete, 1 mm. long, purple. Fig. 74.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: An epiphytic or lithophytic plant, 7–22 cm. high. Pseudobulbs ovoid, conical or cylindrical, 1.2–6.3 cm. long, 0.4–0.8 cm. wide, 2-leaved towards apex, subtended by 2 leaf-bearing sheaths at base. Leaves linear, grass-like, suberect, curved, 8–16 cm. long, 4–8 mm. wide, unequally bilobed at apex. Inflorescence shorter, equal to or longer than the leaves, 6–18 cm. long, subtended at base by 1–2 long narrow compressed acute sheaths; bracts setaceous, as long or longer than flowers, 4–7 mm. long. Flowers minute; sepals yellow, yellow-green or green, ± tipped with purple; lip and petals purple. Dorsal sepal ovate, acuminate, 1.8 mm. long, 1 mm. wide; lateral sepals obliquely ovate, 3.5 mm. long, to 2.5 mm. wide; mentum short, conical, 1.5–2 mm. long. Petals narrowly oblong, subacute, 1.25 mm. long, 0.3 mm. wide. Lip 3-lobed in basal half, 2.3 mm. long, 1.6 mm. wide; side lobes rotund, erect; mid-lobe lanceolate to ovate, reflexed, 1.2 mm. long, 0.5 mm. wide, acute; disc glabrous or sparsely pubescent; callus fleshy, between side lobes, glabrous. Column short, fleshy, truncate, 1.1 mm. long.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: An erect caespitose herb to 26 cm. high, with many thick glabrous greyish roots to 4 mm. in diameter. Stems slender, obscurely pseudobulbous at base; pseudobulbs ovoid, 0.5 cm. long and wide, 2- or more leaved. Leaves linear, suberect, acute, 16 cm. long, 0.5 cm. wide, articulated at base of lamina to a tubular sheath to 7 cm. long. Inflorescence erect, branched, several-flowered, 9 cm. or more long; rhachis completely covered by tubular scarious acute sheaths; branches suberect and short; bracts lanceolate, acuminate, 3 mm. long. Flowers subglabrous, with greenish yellow sepals edged with crimson, yellow petals and a crimson callus, with a spicy scent; pedicel and ovary densely pubescent, almost villose. Dorsal sepal ovate-lanceolate, subacute, 7 mm. long, 2 mm. wide; lateral sepals lanceolate, oblique, subacute, 8 mm. long, 3.5 mm. wide, forming with the column-foot a low subconical mentum 2.5 mm. high. Petals oblanceolate, truncate, obscurely apiculate at the apex, 6 mm. long, 1.2 mm. wide. Lip shortly clawed, 3-lobed in basal half, minutely pubescent at the base only, 6.1 mm. long, 5.1 mm. wide; side lobes porrect, elliptic, rounded at apex; mid- lobe obcordate-subquadrate, apiculate, margin somewhat undulate, 3 mm. long, 4.5 mm. wide. Column stout, 5 mm. long including the foot; stigma transversely oblong; anther-cap hemispherical. Fig. 80, p. 380.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: An epiphytic herb, 21–25 cm. high. Pseudobulbs clustered, from a short creeping rhizome, conical, 2–3.8 cm. long, 5–8 mm. broad, clothed in 3 membranous basal sheaths. Leaf lanceolate to ovate-lanceolate, acute or subacute, cuneate below, 19–24.5 cm. long, 1.4–1.7 cm. broad, coriaceous, articulated 2.5–3 cm. above the apex of the pseudobulb. Inflorescence shorter than the leaf, simply racemose, 9.8–14 cm. long, up to 5 flowers borne in succession; peduncle stout, 7.8–12 cm. long; basal sheath membranaceous, 2 cm. long; bracts spreading, triangular-lanceolate, acuminate, 1.4–2 cm. long. Flowers white, red- and yellow-spotted on lip. Dorsal sepal lanceolate, acuminate, 12–15.8 mm. long, 4.6–4.8 mm. broad; lateral sepals obliquely triangular, subfalcate, apiculate, 10.5–16 mm. long, 7–9.5 mm. broad; mentum ovoid-conical, to 8.5 mm. high. Petals obovate-lanceolate, acute, 10–13.5 mm. long, 3.5–4 mm. broad. Lip strongly recurved, ± clawed, distinctly 3-lobed, 10–11.5 mm. long, 9.5–12.5 mm. broad; side lobes erect, triangular or ovate- triangular, shorter than mid-lobe; mid-lobe rounded-subquadrate, apiculate, glandular- pubescent below, fleshily thickened in centre, 3.5–5 mm. long, 6–7 mm. broad; callus basal, obscurely fleshy. Column semiterete, 2–2.5 mm. long; foot 5–8 mm. long, pubescent; pollinia ovoid.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: A dwarf epiphytic herb to 7.5 cm. high. Pseudobulbs clustered, conical, 1.5 cm. long, 0.6 cm. diameter, yellowish when old, 2–3-leaved at apex. Leaves narrowly elliptic-lanceolate or oblanceolate, 3.2 cm. long, 0.7 cm. wide, acute, articulated 0.8 cm. above pseudobulb. Inflorescence erect, 3–4-flowered, to 5 cm. high; peduncle terete, pubescent; bracts lanceolate, acuminate, 2 mm. long, 1 mm. wide. Flowers pubescent on outer surface; sepals and petals dull mustard-yellow, more or less purplish towards the base; lip white, callus yellowish, side lobes faintly striped with purple. Dorsal sepal ovate, acuminate, 6.8 mm. long, 3.4 mm. wide; lateral sepals obliquely and broadly ovate, acuminate, 6–7.5 mm. long, 5 mm. wide. Petals oblong to oblanceolate, 5 mm. long, 1.5 mm. wide, obtuse. Lip recurved, 3-lobed, shortly clawed, 5 mm. long, 4 mm. wide; side lobes rounded, erect; mid-lobe fleshy, bullate, apex recurved, acute; disc pubescent; callus fleshy, raised, pubescent. Column short, truncate, column-foot 3 mm. long, white with a yellow apex and a purple area between the yellow and white areas. Fig. 83 J–R, p. 388.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: An epiphytic herb 19–30 cm. high. Pseudobulbs tightly clustered, from a short creeping rhizome, narrowly cylindric, 4.5–16.5 cm. long, 1.3–2 mm. in diameter, clothed in 3–4 membranous basal sheaths. Leaf linear, cuneate below, obtuse, 14.5–23 cm. long, 4–11 mm. broad, coriaceous, articulated 1–2 mm. above the apex of the pseudobulb. Inflorescence equal to or longer than the leaf, unbranched, 11–27 cm. long, up to 15-flowered; peduncle slender, 7–25.5 cm. long, with a membranous basal sheath; bracts triangular, amplexicaul, 1.5–2 mm. long. Flowers yellow with a purple lip. Dorsal sepal oblong-elliptic, concave, 2.8–3.5 mm. long, 1.8–2 mm. broad; lateral sepals roundly triangular, 3.5–4.5 mm. long, 2.5–4 mm. broad, mentum subovoid, 3.5 mm. long. Petals linear, subacute, 2.6–3.2 mm. long, 0.4 mm. broad. Lip clawed, strongly recurved, entire, subcordate or triangular, truncate, 3.5–4.5 mm. long, 2.5–3.2 mm. broad, glandular-pubescent above. Column subterete, 1–2.5 mm. long; foot 2.6–3.5 mm. long.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: An epiphytic herb, 5–21 cm. high. Pseudobulbs tightly clustered, from a short creeping rhizome, narrowly cylindric, 0.7–5.7 cm. long, 0.6–2.5 mm. broad, clothed in 3–4 membranous sheaths, ± articulated on basal half. Leaf more or less fleshy, subterete to flat, linear, cuneate below, retuse or obtuse at apex, 2–14.5 cm. long, 2–7 mm. broad, articulated 1–2 mm. above the pseudobulb apex. Inflorescence about as long as the leaf, a 2–6-branched secund raceme, 2.8–15.5 cm. long, up to 40-flowered; peduncle stout, 0.5–13.3 cm. long, bearing 1–4 short membranous sheaths, the lowermost 1–several mm. above the base; bracts triangular, amplexicaul, mostly apiculate, 0.4–2 mm. long. Flowers yellow to yellow- green; column, side lobes of lip and mentum tinged purple. Dorsal sepal elliptic to ovate- triangular, concave, shortly apiculate, 1.5–3.5 mm. long, 0.7–2.2 mm. broad; lateral sepals obliquely triangular, 2–4.5 mm. long, 2–6 mm. broad; mentum subcylindric, up to 5 mm. long. Petals narrowly oblong-lanceolate to linear, subacute, 1.7–3 mm. long, 0.6–1.6 mm. broad. Lip strongly recurved, distinctly clawed, distinctly 3-lobed in the apical third, 2.5–6.5 mm. long, 1.7–4 mm. broad; side lobes erect, oblong to ovate, rounded or obtuse; mid-lobe rounded-subquadrate, fleshy, 0.7–2.4 mm. long, 0.8–2 mm. broad; callus obscure, fleshy, at base of mid-lobe. Column subterete, 0.3–1 mm. long; foot 2.5 mm. long; pollinia ovoid.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: An epiphytic plant (9–)20–62 cm. long. Stems pseudobulbous at base, to 15 cm. long, 0.7 cm. wide, 3–5-leaved; pseudobulbs ovoid, 0.6–1.3 cm. long, 0.5–0.8 cm. diameter. Leaves suberect, somewhat distichous, oblanceolate, elliptic or oblong-elliptic, minutely unequally bilobed at apex, obtuse or rounded, 13–30 cm. long, 1.3–5.7 cm. wide. Inflorescence much longer than the leaves, paniculate, 18–47 cm. long; peduncle terete, covered with scarious imbricating sheaths; rhachis more or less covered with papery acute sheaths, sparsely pubescent; branches secund, distant, 1–5 cm. long, densely many-flowered; bracts linear-lanceolate, acuminate, 2–4 mm. long. Flowers sparsely pubescent on outer surface, very variable in colour, creamy yellow, pale green, pink or dull red, lip white with a pink mid-lobe. Dorsal sepal oblong-elliptic, acute, 3–4.3 mm. long, 1.8–2.3 mm. wide; lateral sepals obliquely ovate, apiculate, 3–5.6 mm. long, 2.8–3.6 mm. wide, forming with the column-foot a conical mentum to 3.4 mm. high. Petals ligulate to spathulate, apiculate, 2–3.6 mm. long, 0.6–1.1 mm. wide. Lip clawed, 3-lobed at or above the middle, 3.5–5.2 mm. long, 2.5–4 mm. wide; side lobes falcately oblong, subacute or obtuse, 1.2 mm. long; mid-lobe suborbicular, emarginate, tessellated when dry, margins crenulate-undulate, 1.6–2.5 mm. long, 2–2.2 mm. wide; callus a fleshy ridge 1.7 mm. long, tapering towards the base and rounded at the apex. Column 1–1.6 mm. long.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: An erect epiphytic plant, 7–53 cm. high. Stems terete, 4–45 cm. long, completely covered by imbricating leaf bases, 5–8-leaved. Leaves distichous, well spaced on stem, ligulate or linear-lanceolate, rounded or obtuse at apex, 4.5–13 cm. long, 7–20 mm. wide, drying black. Inflorescence erect, shorter to slightly longer than the leaves, unbranched or weakly 1–3-branched, 3–13 cm. long; peduncle and rhachis terete, 1–6 cm. long, sparsely pubescent; bracts ovate, acuminate, recurved, 3–7 cm. long. Flowers erect, glabrous on outer surface, sepals cream, yellow, yellow-green, green or orange variously suffused with brown or purple, petals and lip dull cream to greenish veined with maroon. Dorsal sepal ovate, acute or subacute, 5.4–8.2 mm. long, 2.5–4.2 mm. wide; lateral sepals obliquely triangular, acute or acuminate, 8.4–11.3 mm. long, 6.2–9.5 mm. wide; mentum cylindric-conical, 5.5–9 mm. long. Petals oblanceolate-subspathulate, acute to obtuse, 4.8–6.6 mm. long, 1.1–1.9 mm. wide. Lip long-clawed, recurved, obscurely 3-lobed in apical half, sinuses between the mid-lobe and side lobes obscure, 6.6–10.5 mm. long, 5.7–8 mm. wide; side lobes rounded; mid-lobe broadly triangular, 2.5 mm. long, 3.6 mm. wide, subacute, obtuse or shortly apiculate. Column semi-terete, 2.5 mm. long.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: A many-stemmed, erect or pendulous epiphytic or lithophytic plant, glabrous except for the inflorescence. Stems caespitose, slender, to 30 cm. long; annual stem superposed, emitted from the apical half of the preceding growth, narrowly cylindrical fusiform, terete, to 9 cm. long, 2 mm. diameter, at first covered with a few sheaths, 2–4-leaved towards apex. Leaves suberect, oblong- or lanceolate-ligulate, apex subacutely bilobed, 3–10 cm. long, 5–11 mm. wide. Inflorescence unbranched, 4–7 cm. long, sublaxly 3–9-flowered; peduncle slender, ± flexuose, 2.5–3.5 cm. long, pubescent; bracts erect-spreading, narrowly lanceolate, acuminate, to 1 cm. long. Flowers suberect, dull violet-red and green; lip mid-lobe creamy and side-lobes pinkish; pedicel and ovary 5–7 mm. long, densely pubescent. Dorsal sepal broadly lanceolate, acute or acuminate, 5.5–6 mm. long, 2.5–3.25 mm. wide; lateral sepals obliquely lanceolate- triangular, acuminate, 9 mm. long, 5.25–6.25 mm. wide, forming with the column-foot a conical mentum 4.5–5.5 mm. long. Petals oblanceolate, acute, 4.5–5 mm. long, 1–1.5 mm. wide. Lip recurved, with a long claw, 3-lobed in apical half, 7.5 mm. long, 4.5 mm. wide; mid-lobe orbicular-ovate, apex acute, recurved, 3 mm. long and wide; side lobes ± triangular, acute, 1.2 mm. wide; disc glabrous; callus fleshy, 3-toothed. Column fleshy, 1.5–2 mm. long, truncate; foot 5 mm. long.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: A caespitose epiphytic or terrestrial herb to 21 cm. tall. Pseudobulbs narrowly conical, 3.5 cm. long, 0.9 cm. in diameter. Leaf erect, oblanceolate, acute, 14–16.5 cm. long, 1.6–1.8 cm. broad. Inflorescence shorter than the leaf, glabrous, up to 11 cm. long, 4–5-flowered, branches 0–1; peduncle wiry, somewhat arcuate, 8.5 cm. long; rhachis short, 1.5–2.5 cm. long; bracts distichous, ovate, acuminate, 6 mm. long. Flowers creamy yellow or white, sweetly scented. Dorsal sepal oblong-lanceolate, acuminate, 10.5 mm. long, 4 mm. broad; lateral sepals obliquely ovate, acute, 9 mm. long, 8 mm. broad, keeled on reverse; mentum conical, 6.5 mm. high. Petals oblong-oblanceolate, obtuse, 7–8.6 mm. long, 2–2.8 mm. broad. Lip obscurely 3-lobed in the middle, 9 mm. long, 5 mm. broad; side lobes erect, rounded; mid-lobe fleshy, ovate-lanceolate, apiculate; callus a narrow fleshy ridge between the side lobes to the middle of the lip. Column short, subterete, 2.5 mm. long. Fig. 73, p. 346.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: An erect epiphytic or rarely lithophytic plant up to 50 cm. high. Stems approximate, pseudobulbous, narrowly cylindric-conical, 1–3 cm. high, 5–10 mm. diameter, covered with a few acute scarious sheaths, 2–3-leaved above. Leaves suberect, ligulate-linear, rounded and obscurely bilobed at apex, 5–25 cm. long, 3–8 mm. wide. Inflorescence often very much longer than the leaves, simply racemose or several- branched, 7–48 cm. high; peduncle 5–23 cm. high, covered with flattened acute sheaths; rhachis bearing up to 7 secund branches, each to 2–5-flowered, bare rhachis densely pubescent; bracts lanceolate, acuminate, 3–7 mm. long. Flowers erect- spreading, straw-coloured to light brown; pedicel and ovary 5–10 mm. long, densely pubescent. Dorsal sepal slightly incurved, lanceolate or oblong-lanceolate, acute, 6.5–9.5 mm. long, 2–4.5 mm. wide; lateral sepals obliquely and narrowly triangular, acuminate, 8.5–11.5 mm. long, 5–5.5 mm. wide; mentum incurving, cylindric-conical, rotund, 3.5–4.5 mm. long; sepals all sparsely pubescent on outside. Petals obliquely oblanceolate, acute, 6–8.5 mm. long, 1.5–2 mm. wide. Lip recurved, shortly clawed, 3-lobed at or above the middle, 7.5–9.25 mm. long, 5.25–6 mm. wide; side lobes erect, rotund-triangular, clavate-hairy in front; mid-lobe recurved, ovate or broadly ovate, acuminate-apiculate, 2.5–4 mm. long, 3–3.25 mm. wide, margins undulate, densely clavate-hairy in centre. Column porrect, semiterete, 2.5 mm. long.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: A large epiphytic or lithophytic plant to 20 cm. high. Pseudobulbs clustered, fusiform to conical, several-noded, 3.5–4 cm. long, 1.3–1.5 cm. wide, 3–4-leaved towards apex, drying glossy yellow or orange. Leaves oblanceolate or oblong-ligulate, to 18 cm. long, 2.5 cm. wide, rounded at apex. Inflorescence erect, to 15 cm. high, villose; flowers clustered towards apex; bracts broadly ovate, acuminate, 9–12 mm. long, 4.5 mm. wide, villous. Flowers very villous outside; sepals pale cream or whitish green, lip white with minute purple spots on the disc and a light yellow line in the basal half. Dorsal sepal ovate, acuminate, 7.5 mm. long, 3 mm. wide; lateral sepals obliquely lanceolate, acuminate, to 9.5 mm. long, 4.5 mm. wide. Petals oblong-lanceolate, 6 mm. long, 1.5 mm. wide, acute. Lip recurved, 3-lobed, 5 mm. long, 3.6 mm. wide; side lobes erect, rounded, mid-lobe bullate, acute or acuminate, 2.7 mm. long and wide; disc glabrous or papillate with a scarcely apparent callus between the side lobes.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: An epiphytic herb, 16–37 cm. high. Pseudobulbs from a short creeping rhizome, loosely clustered, cylindrical to narrowly conical, compressed, 5.7–11 cm. long, 7.5–10 cm. in diameter, clothed in 3 membranous basal sheaths. Leaf lanceolate to ovate-lanceolate, obtuse, cuneate at the base, 12–26 cm. long, 9.5–30 mm. broad, coriaceous, articulated 1 mm. above the apex of the pseudobulb. Inflorescence shorter than the leaf, simply racemose, 4–9 cm. long, up to 10 flowers borne successively; peduncle stout, 2.7–5.6 cm. long, with an inflated papery basal sheath; bracts ovate- triangular, amplexicaul, 3–5.3 mm. long. Flowers white, fragrant. Dorsal sepal ovate- triangular, shortly apiculate, 8.7–12 mm. long, 4.5–7.5 mm. broad; lateral sepals obliquely triangular or ovate-triangular, 8.5–12 mm. long, 4.5–9.5 mm. broad; mentum conical, to 9.5 mm. high. Petals elliptic to ovate, acute or obtuse, 8–13 mm. long, 3–4.5 mm. broad. Lip strongly recurved in the middle, sessile, ± distinctly 3-lobed, 11.5–15.5 mm. long, 8.4–11 mm. broad; side lobes erect, elliptic to rounded; mid-lobe triangular to triangular-subquadrate, 4–6 mm. long, 4–6.5 mm. broad at base, apiculate; callus central, fleshy, column subterete, 1–3 mm. long; foot 7–9.5 mm. long; pollinia ovoid.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: An epiphytic or lithophytic plant 11–25 cm. high. Pseudobulbs clustered on a short thick rhizome, conical, 1.6–3.5 cm. long, 0.6 cm. wide, 2-leaved at apex, subtended when young by several sheaths, the longest of which may be leaf-bearing. Leaves ligulate, linear or narrowly linear-lanceolate, 6–16 cm. long, 0.7–1.2 cm. wide, obscurely unequally bilobed at apex. Inflorescence erect, compressed, racemose, somewhat curved towards apex, 4–14 cm. long, subtended at base by 1–2 long acute sheaths; bracts setaceous, 3–8 mm. long, 0.5 mm. wide, long-acuminate. Flowers cream-coloured, yellow or yellow-green mostly with a red margin; column and lip red. Dorsal sepal lanceolate or ovate, concave, acuminate, 4 mm. long, 2 mm. wide; lateral sepals very obliquely ovate-lanceolate, acuminate, 9–11 mm. long, 4 mm. wide; mentum narrow, helmet-shaped, 7 mm. long. Petals linear-oblong, 2 mm. long, 1 mm. wide, acute. Lip with a long claw, 3-lobed in apical half, 7.5 mm. long, 4.5 mm. wide; side lobes oblong-rounded, 2 mm. wide; mid-lobe rotund to transversely oval, 3 mm. wide, 2.5 mm. long, apex rounded, papillose. Column short, fleshy, 2 mm. long.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: An erect to pendulous epiphytic plant 13–28 cm. long. Stems clustered, pseudo- bulbous below, terete above, 2–3 cm. long, 2–3 mm. wide; pseudobulbs narrowly conical, 1 cm. long, 4 mm. wide. Leaves 3, linear-ligulate, suberect to spreading, rounded or shortly unequally bilobed at apex, articulated 0.5–1.5 cm. above the base, 3.5–11 cm. long, 5–7 mm. wide. Inflorescence much longer than the leaves, unbranched, 11–23 cm. long, 3–10-flowered; peduncle terete, densely pubescent, 7–20 cm. long; rhachis terete, densely pubescent; bracts ovate, acuminate, 2–3 mm. long. Flowers erect-spreading, white with a greenish mentum, sepals tipped with purple, scent of anise, drying dark brown-black; pedicel and ovary pubescent. Dorsal sepal narrowly oblong-lanceolate, obtuse or mucronate, 9 mm. long, 3 cm. wide; lateral sepals obliquely oblong-lanceolate, mucronate or rounded at apex, 10 mm. long 4 mm. wide; mentum shallow, conical, 3.5 mm. high. Petals shortly clawed, lamina ovate to orbicular, 6.3–8.4 mm. long, 3–3.5 mm. wide, obtuse or mucronate. Lip shortly clawed, recurved, very obscurely 3-lobed below the middle, 7.5–8.5 mm. long, 4.6–5 mm. wide; side lobes obscure, narrowly oblong; mid-lobe ovate, acute, densely clavate papillose, 4.5 mm. long, 3.6 mm. wide; disc with a central fleshy keel to one-third the length of the lip. Column semiterete, 2.5 mm. long.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: A small epiphytic or lithophytic plant to 10 cm. high. Pseudobulbs ovoid to shortly cylindrical, 10–19 mm. long, 6 mm. diameter, subcompressed, 2–3-leaved towards apex. Leaves oblong or lanceolate-oblong, 3–8 cm. long, 6–14 mm. wide, obtuse, conduplicate at the base, glaucescent and keeled beneath. Inflorescence erect, 4–8- flowered, 5–7.5 cm. long, pubescent; bracts broadly rhomboid-ovate, papery, whitish, acuminate, 4–6 mm. long, 4.5 mm. wide. Flowers pubescent outside, lemon-yellow to greenish yellow with a deep brown spot at the base of the column-foot and light purple veining of the side lobes of the lip. Dorsal sepal ovate, acute, 8–10 mm. long, 4 mm. wide; lateral sepals keeled on back, 9–10 mm. long, 4 mm. wide, acute to acuminate. Petals oblanceolate to linear-oblong, incurved, 6.6 mm. long, 1.8 mm. wide. Lip recurved strongly, 3-lobed, 6 mm. long, 4.1 mm. wide; side lobes erect, rounded, mid-lobe fleshy, bullate, reflexed at apex, acute; callus fleshy, raised, densely papillate-hairy to base of lip. Column very short, 1.5 mm. long.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: Shrub or small slender tree 3–9(–?15) m. tall, with laxly branched stems; young branchlets densely pubescent but later glabrous, pale and rugose. Leaf-blades elliptic or oblanceolate-elliptic, 11–30 cm. long, 5–16 cm. wide (or probably larger), acute at the apex, cuneate at the base, venation fine and reticulate beneath, pale and ± prominent in the dry state; midrib with fine bristly hairs above but otherwise glabrous; venation beneath bristly pubescent (see note for specimens with a much denser indumentum); petiole 0.8–2 cm. long; stipules elliptic, 1–1.2 cm. long, 4.5–6 mm. wide, pubescent, soon deciduous. Flowers pendulous, several in inflorescences up to about 10 cm. long; peduncles and secondary peduncles 0.8–1.7 cm. long; pedicels 0.7–1.7 cm. long; all parts ferruginous pubescent Calyx-tube obconic, 7 mm. long, ferruginous pubescent; tubular part of limb 8 mm. long, pubescent outside, densely hairy inside; lobes ± triangular, (0.35–)0.6–1 cm. long, pubescent, the tube with winged ribs decurrent below the lobes. Corolla cream outside, sometimes tinged pink or red, deep red-crimson-brown inside, funnel-shaped above, constricted and tubular at the base, upper part 1.6–2.5 cm. long, silky pilose outside, basal part 1 cm. long, glabrous outside in the lower part; lobes rounded, 1 cm. long and wide, silky pilose save for glabrous overlapped part. Anthers ± yellow. Style, and stigma ± yellow. Fruits ? orange, said to be as large as an egg; those seen are immature, ellipsoid to fusiform, 3–5 cm. long, 1.6–2 cm. wide, ± ribbed. Fig. 77.
bibliographicCitation: Rubiaceae, B. Verdcourt. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1976

description: Shrub or small tree 0.9–7 m tall with pale grey bark. Leaves opposite, elliptic, or oblong-elliptic, 2.8–7 cm long, 1.5–4 cm wide, obtuse at the apex, smooth and glossy olive-green above, densely white-tomentose beneath. Flowers in 1–3-flowered axillary or terminal cymes. Calyx-tube and outside of lobes white-tomentose. Petals white or pink outside, crimson-purple or lilac-pink inside, up to 2 cm long. Stamens 1.5–2.5 cm long, with crimson or purple filaments and yellow anthers. Fruit dull green or yellow-green, often with dull red or orange blush, oblong or ellipsoid-ovoid, 2.5–8 cm long, 2.8–5 cm wide. Fig. 4/4–5, p. 14.
bibliographicCitation: Myrtaceae, B. Verdcourt, B.Sc., Ph.D. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 2001

description: Tree 4.5–21 (–27) m. tall with spreading crown, less often shrubby; bole often crooked, usually hollow, sometimes fluted; bark pale grey or reddish and grey, finely furrowed; slash soft pale brown to white, yellowish towards wood with scattered orange-brown flecks; branches ± horizontal; branchlets sparsely pubescent and glandular then glabrous, less often ± densely pubescent. Leaves mostly in whorls of 4, less often paired; blades ovate, oblong or elliptic, 4.5–20.5 cm. long, 3–13(–17) cm. wide, acuminate at the apex, rounded, cuneate or subcordate at the base, glabrous above and pubescent beneath on main nerves, later glabrescent or rarely densely pubescent all over (see note), glandular-punctate; midrib impressed above and the ± parallel venation mostly finely prominent; all main venation prominent beneath; petiole 3–10 cm. long. Flowers small in large thyrsoid panicles 12–30 cm. long, the main branches in whorls of 2–5, 3–9 cm. long; bracts linear to lanceolate, 0.2–1 cm. long; pedicels obsolete or under 1 mm. long. Calyx 1.5–2 mm. long, truncate or obscurely 2-lipped, glabrescent to pubescent. Corolla white, sometimes tinged green or ? mauve, glabrous outside; tube 2–2.5(–3) mm. long; lobes 1 mm. long, ± semicircular, tomentose-pubescent inside. Anthers brown, just exserted. Fruits green turning purple, globose, 4–5 mm. diameter; calycine cup shallow, 3.5 mm. diameter.
bibliographicCitation: Verbenaceae, B. Verdcourt. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1992

description: Much-branched shrub or small tree 1–6(–8) m. tall, occasionally somewhat scandent; branchlets coarsely velvety with very dense rusty or orange-brown multibranched hairs, sometimes quite long; older stems glabrescent, eventually glabrous, pale brown, ridged and ± corky. Leaves variable, opposite, aromatic; blades elliptic, oblong, oblong-obovate or obovate-lanceolate, 1.5–9.5 cm. long, 0.8–6 cm. wide, acute to acuminate at the apex, rarely ± rounded, narrowly rounded, broadly cuneate or rounded at the base, entire or obscurely to distinctly crenate or toothed, thinly pubescent to velvety above with small stellate hairs and longer simple hairs which may, however, be missing, and similarly pubescent or velvety beneath particularly on the raised nerves; gland-dots dense but obscure; petiole 0.5–1.2 cm. long. Flowers small in dense mostly elongate much-branched complicated terminal panicles 1–7 cm. long; bracts filiform, 4 mm. long; pedicels 0.5 mm. long; axes pubescent like the stems. Calyx cupular, 1.8 mm. long, truncate or with 5 short teeth to 0.5 mm. long, glandular and densely stellate-pubescent. Corolla greenish white or cream to yellow, glandular and slightly puberulous outside; tube 2.5–4 mm. long; limb 2-lipped, the lobes rounded to oblong, 1.2–2 mm. long, 1.3–1.5 mm. wide. Style green, forked at tip. Drupes black or purplish black, ellipsoid to obovoid, 4.5–6 mm. long, 4–4.5 mm. wide, pubescent, sitting in a cup 3.5 mm. wide.
bibliographicCitation: Verbenaceae, B. Verdcourt. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1992

description: Climber or shrub 3–10 m. tall with arching branches, with glabrous pale grey-brown striate lenticellate corky stems; young shoots glabrous to pubescent. Leaves borne on rather short lateral shoots, fragrant; blades elliptic-oblong, very slightly obovate, 4–15 cm. long, 2.5–7.5 cm. wide, acute, very shortly acuminate or ± rounded at the apex, cuneate at the base, slightly to very discolorous beneath, pubescent and tomentose or ± glabrous, entire or very obscurely undulate, both surfaces with raised finely reticulate venation when dry; petiole 0.8–1.8 cm. long. Dichasia pale yellowish green in life, drying orange-brown, 2–6 cm. long, 3–8 cm. wide, glabrous or pubescent; peduncle 1–2 cm. long; pedicels 1 mm. long. Calyx not lobed or slightly so. Corolla white; tube 2 mm. long, densely hairy inside; lobes oblong-ovate, 1.5–1.8 mm. long, 1.2 mm. wide. Fruit white turning purple-black, 4–6 mm. in diameter; calycine cup 2 mm. tall, 4–5 mm. wide, obscurely veined or very veined except near the entire margin.
bibliographicCitation: Verbenaceae, B. Verdcourt. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1992

description: Small brittle-stemmed erect or scandent shrub or “contorted bush” 1–3 m. tall, fragrant; stems slender, grey or purplish grey, glabrous or pubescent. Leaf-blades fragrant, ovate to oblong, 1.2–6 cm. long, 0.8–3.4 cm. wide, acuminate at the apex, rounded at the base, thin, entire to coarsely 1–3-dentate on either side, almost lobed, ± glabrous but obscurely minutely glandular or with hairs at base of costa beneath, with only 2 main nerves on either side; petiole very slender, 0.2–1 cm. long, mostly sparsely puberulous to densely pubescent. Inflorescences small, terminal but often overtopped by leaf pair from lower node, 1–1.5 cm. long, 1–3 cm. wide; peduncles 0.5–2 cm. long, slightly puberulous; pedicels up to 3 mm. long in fruit; bracts oblong to lanceolate, 2–3 mm. long. Calyx 1.5–2 mm. long, slightly lobed, glabrous, obscurely glandular. Corolla white; tube 2.5 mm. long; largest lobe 1.5 mm. long. Fruit obovoid, 3.5–4 mm. long, 2.5–3 mm. wide, ± ridged in dry state, sitting in a shallow cup 2.5 mm. wide.
bibliographicCitation: Verbenaceae, B. Verdcourt. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1992

description: Shrub ± 1 m. tall or tree (fide Gillman); young stems densely spreading white pubescent, later glabrous and strongly ridged. Leaf-blades drying ± dark brown, ± round to rounded-oblong or somewhat obovate, 2–7.5 cm. long, 2–7 cm. wide, rounded to shortly acuminate at the apex, ± round to truncate at the base, entire or with obscure to ± distinct teeth towards the apex, slightly discolorous, densely softly hairy above with whitish long and short hairs with incrassated glandular bases, the surface appearing granular, also hairy on the main nerves beneath but areas between ± glabrous; petiole 0.5–2 cm. long. Inflorescences ± 3.5 cm. long, ± 6 cm. wide, overtopped by upper leaves; peduncle and secondary branches 1–1.5 cm. long; pedicels 0.5 mm. long; all axes spreading white pubescent; bracts linear, 7 mm. long; secondary bracts and bracteoles filiform, 0.5–2 mm. long. Calyx adpressed white pubescent; tube 2–2.5 mm. long; lobes ovate-triangular, 0.5 mm. long. Corolla white; tube cylindrical, 3–4 mm. long, sparsely hairy above and throat pubescent; 3 short lobes ovate, 1.2 mm. long, 1.5 mm. wide and 1 longer lobe 2 mm. long, 1.5 mm. wide; stamens exserted. Style 4.5 mm. long. Fruit 6 mm. in diameter in calycine cup 7 mm. in diameter.
bibliographicCitation: Verbenaceae, B. Verdcourt. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1992

description: Climbing shrub to 12 m. or small straggling tree or bush 3–6 m. tall; young ± slender leafy shoots brownish red, lenticellate, densely covered with spreading pale brownish pubescence; main stems leafless with purplish brown peeling epidermis, up to 10 cm. in diameter (fide Ament & Magogo 57), striate, pubescent but at length glabrous or with scattered pubescence and often densely woolly buds in axes of fallen leaves. Leaf-blades ovate to ± oblong-elliptic, 3–15 cm. long, 2.5–8.5(–10) cm. wide, narrowly distinctly acuminate at the apex or ? abnormally rounded, truncate to rounded or subcordate at the base, usually entire but ± repand or obscurely toothed in some southern specimens, thin, sometimes discolorous, thinly velvety above with very obvious multicellular ± adpressed hairs and more thickly similarly velvety beneath but finely so in both cases; petiole slender, 0.9–5 cm. long, similarly pubescent to the stems. Flowers very sweetly scented in extensive ± dense panicles of cymes 6–10 cm. long and wide, the axes similarly pubescent to the stems; bracts linear to lanceolate, 3–8 mm. long; pedicels to 1 mm. long. Calyx obconic, 2.2 mm. long, densely adpressed white pubescent; lobes short, very rounded or triangular, 0.5–1 mm. long, less pubescent and drying brownish. Corolla white or yellow-green; tube 3 mm. long, ± glabrous; lobes rounded, 1–1.5 mm. long and wide, densely adpressed pubescent outside. Fruit black, ellipsoid or ± globose, 6–7 mm. long, 5–6 mm. wide, ± minutely glandular, sitting in a ± flat or shallow pubescent persistent calyx.
bibliographicCitation: Verbenaceae, B. Verdcourt. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1992
