Spadix 2–3.7 cm. long, slightly shorter than spathe; staminate part cylindric to clavate, 1.2–2.2 cm. long, 0.5–0.6 cm. in diameter, apex rounded, base narrowing, with tepals cream, pistillodes white, equalling tepals; sterile part centrally constricted, 0.5–1.2 cm. long, 0.3–0.5 cm. in diameter, tepals greenish cream, pistillodes prominent; pistillate part conic, 0.4–0.6 cm. long, 0.7–0.9 cm. in diameter, tepals pinkish brown. Staminate flower: staminal tube equalling tepals; anthers not exserted. Pistillate flower: pistil laterally flattened, ovate, 3 mm. long, 2 mm. broad, ovary 2-locular, locules uniovulate, placentation at base of septum; stigma 1–1.5 mm. broad, ± discoid, green. Fruit not seen.
bibliographicCitation: Araceae, S.J. Mayo. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1985

description: Tuber subglobose, up to ± 8 cm. in diameter. Leaf 30–95 cm. long, shortly pilose to glabrous; petiole not distinctly developed; leaflets extending to ground-level; subterranean axis slightly thicker, forming basal cylindric pulvinus; blade oblanceolate in outline, 12–40 cm. broad at widest point, pinnately to bipinnately lobed; pinnae borne in opposite pairs; basal pairs reduced to tufts of oblanceolate to linear, long-stipitate foliar projections; ultimate leaflets of larger pinnae elliptic to oblanceolate, 6–20 cm. long, 2.5–6 cm. broad, glossy dark green on upper surface, shortly acuminate, those of large central pinnae decurrent, simple apical pairs cuneate, sessile or shortly petiolulate. Inflorescence solitary. Peduncle 9–42 cm. long, 0.5–0.8 cm. in diameter, erect, terete, minutely pilose. Spathe 5–17.5 cm. long; tube broadly suburceolate, only slightly constricted at mouth, widely distant (by 3–5 mm.) from pistillate flowers, 1.5–3 cm. long, 1.3–2.7 cm. in diameter; limb oblong to oblong-elliptic, 3.5–14.5 cm. long, 2.2–5 cm. broad, reflexed, bright green, paler within, cuspidate, outer surface sometimes shortly pilose. Spadix 4.7–15 cm. long; staminate part cylindric to clavate, 3.2–11.5 cm. long, 0.7–1.1 cm. in diameter, cream, apex rounded, base slightly constricted; sterile intermediate part 0.2–0.4 cm. long, 0.3–0.8 cm. in diameter at narrowest part; pistillate part cylindric, 1–3 cm. long, 0.6–1.3 cm. in diameter. Pistillate flower with pale green tepals; ovary 2-locular, locules uniovulate, placentas at base of septum; stigma capitate-discoid, 1.5 mm. in diameter.
bibliographicCitation: Araceae, S.J. Mayo. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1985

description: A dwarf epiphyte with very short stems less than 5 mm. long, sometimes appearing leafless. Roots very long, flattened, 1–2 mm. across, much more prominent than the leaves. Leaves 1–3, deciduous, linear, obtuse, 1–3.5 cm. long, 0.3–0.5 cm. wide, twisted and articulated at the base. Inflorescences pendent, secund, 3–13 cm. long, densely 10–20-flowered; peduncle 1–2.5 cm. long, wiry, very slender; bracts sheathing, ovate, obtuse, 1–1.5 mm. long. Flowers cream or pale green; pedicel and ovary 6–7 mm. long. Dorsal sepal elliptic-oblanceolate, obtuse, 4–4.2 mm. long, 1–1.7 mm. wide; lateral sepals linear, acute, 6.5–7 mm. long, 1 mm. wide. Petals obliquely lanceolate, acute, 3.5–4.5 mm. long, 1.5–1.6 mm. wide. Lip 3-lobed, 4 mm. long, 1.5 mm. wide; side lobes obscurely auriculate; mid-lobe linear. Spur cylindrical, straight or incurved, 7–13 mm. long. Column 0.5–0.6 mm. long; rostellum 3-lobed, with truncate side lobes; stipites 2, short; viscidium 1, oblong. Fig. 149/11–21, p. 600.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: A dwarf epiphyte with a very short stem less than 5 mm. long, often appearing leafless. Roots much more prominent than the leaves, dense, flattened on the substrate, 1.5–3 mm. wide. Leaves linear-elliptic to oblanceolate, acute, 1.5–4 cm. long, 0.3–0.4 cm. wide, dull green. Inflorescences 7–9 cm. long, secund, densely up to 15-flowered; peduncle 1 cm. long, bearing 3–4 bracts; bracts distichous, funnel-like, 1–1.5 mm. long, blackish. Flowers pale green or pale yellow-green with a brown tip to the spur, slightly scented; pedicel and ovary 5–6 mm. long. Dorsal sepal oblong-elliptic, obtuse, 3–5 mm. long, 1.5–1.6 mm. wide; lateral sepals similar. Petals lanceolate, obtuse, 2.7–4 mm. long, 1–1.4 mm. wide. Lip obscurely 3-lobed at the base, lanceolate, acute, 3.7–4.6 mm. long, 1.5–1.8 mm. wide; side lobes auriculate. Spur clavate, 4.5–5 mm. long. Column 1 mm. long; rostellum 3-lobed; stipites 2, short; viscidium 1, linear-elliptic. Fig. 149/22.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: An epiphyte with a short pendent stem, 1–7 cm. long. Leaves falcate, linear, obtusely bilobed at the oblique apex, twisted to lie in one plane at the base and articulated to imbricate leaf-sheaths. Inflorescences 4–16.5 cm. long, 4–14-flowered; peduncle (2–)7–11 cm. long; bracts sheathing, conical, acute, 2–3 mm. long. Flowers white; pedicel and ovary 1.7–2.7 cm. long. Dorsal sepal ovate, obtuse, 2–3.1 mm. long, 1.3–1.5 mm. wide; lateral sepals dependent, spathulate, rounded, 7.5–9 mm. long, 1.6–1.7 mm. wide. Petals obliquely ovate-triangular, acute, 2.2–5 mm. long, 2.7–5.5 mm. wide, adnate to the lateral sepals for the basal 2–4 mm. Lip 3-lobed, 5–5.5 mm. long, 2–2.5 mm. wide; side lobes linear, 1.3–1.5 mm. long, less than half the length of the mid-lobe; mid-lobe oblanceolate, 4.5–4.7 mm. long, 1–1.3 mm. wide, rounded at the apex. Spur cylindrical, 3.8–4 cm. long. Column 1 mm. long; stipites 2, linear; viscidia 2, subcircular.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: A dwarf epiphyte or rarely a lithophyte with a very short stem less than 5 mm. long. Roots flattened, 2 mm. wide. Leaves linear, obtuse, 4–9 cm. long, 0.4–0.6 cm. wide, twisted and articulated at the base. Inflorescences 4–5 cm. long, laxly few–8-flowered; peduncle 1–2 cm. long, very slender, wiry; bracts ovate, acute, 1–1.5 mm. long. Flowers pale green turning yellow with age; pedicel and ovary 5–10 mm. long. Dorsal sepal elliptic, obtuse, 3–3.3 mm. long, 1.5–1.8 mm. wide; lateral sepals oblanceolate, rounded, 4.5 mm. long, 1.6–1.7 mm. wide. Petals obliquely ovate, obtuse, 3 mm. long, 1.8–2 mm. wide. Lip entire, ovate, obtuse, 3 mm. long, 1.6–1.8 mm. wide. Spur narrowly cylindrical, slightly incurved, 14–22.5 mm. long. Column 0.7 mm. long; rostellum 3-lobed, short; stipites 2, slender; viscidia 2.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: A dwarf epiphyte with a very short stem up to 0.5 cm. long. Roots wiry, 0.5 mm. in diameter. Leaves 3–5, linear-ligulate to oblanceolate, unequally roundly bilobed at the apex, 2–2.75 cm. long, 3–4 mm. wide, twisted to lie in one plane at the base. Inflorescences secund, less than 2.5 cm. long, 4–8-flowered; peduncle 4–9 mm. long; bracts amplexicaul, ovate-triangular, acute, 0.5–0.8 mm. long. Flowers tiny, pale greenish white, all segments somewhat recurved; pedicel and ovary 3–5 mm. long. Dorsal sepal elliptic-oblong, acute to obtuse, 3 mm. long, 1 mm. wide; lateral sepals obliquely narrowly elliptic, acute to obtuse, 3 mm. long, 1 mm. wide. Petals oblong-elliptic, acute, 2.5 mm. long, 1 mm. wide. Lip slighdy recurved, ovate, acute and fleshy at the apex, 2 mm. long, 1 mm. wide. Spur slightly incurved, clavate, 1–2 mm. long, notched at the apex. Column 0.5 mm. long; rostellum 3-lobed, with papillate side lobes produced above and below into acute tips and mid-lobe pendent and acute; pollinia 2; stipites 2, linear; viscidia 2, narrowly elliptic.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: A pendent epiphyte with a short stem 3–6 cm. long. Roots verrucose. Leaves 2–4, falcate, linear to oblanceolate, unequally acutely or subacutely bilobed at the apex, 13–33.5 cm. long, 1.4–2.2 cm. wide, twisted at the base and articulated to imbricate leaf-sheaths, 2–3 cm. long. Inflorescences 10–20 cm. long, many-flowered; peduncle 6.5–8.5 cm. long; bracts triangular, 1 mm. long. Flowers white; pedicel and ovary 0.8–1.3 cm. long. Dorsal sepal elliptic, obtuse, 2.4–2.6 mm. long, 2–2.2 mm. wide; lateral sepals spathulate, rounded, 5.5–5.7 mm. long, 1.7–1.8 mm. wide. Petals obliquely ovate-triangular, acute, 2.5 mm. long, 2.7–3 mm. wide. Lip 3-lobed in the middle, 5.5–6.5 mm. long, 4 mm. wide, subauriculate at the base; side lobes linear-lanceolate, subacute, 1–1.5 mm. long; mid-lobe narrowly elliptic, obtuse, longer than the side lobes, 2.5 mm. long. Spur incurved, cylindrical, swollen at the apex, 10–11 mm. long. Column 1.5–2 mm. long; foot 1.5 mm. long; rostellum deeply 3-lobed; stipites 2, oblanceolate; viscidia 2, linear.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: A dwarf epiphyte with a very short stem, 2–4 mm. long. Roots slender, terete, less than 1 mm. in diameter. Leaves 2–4, linear-oblanceolate, obtuse, 1.5–2 cm. long, 2–4 mm. wide, twisted at the base to lie in one plane. Inflorescences 1.5–2.5 cm. long, 2–5-flowered; peduncle very finely wiry, 5–10 mm. long; bracts amplexicaul, ovate-triangular, acute, 0.5 mm. long. Flowers minute, greenish white; pedicel and ovary 2–3 mm. long. Dorsal sepal elliptic, obtuse or subacute, 1.5 mm. long, 0.7–0.8 mm. wide; lateral sepals oblanceolate, acute, 2 mm. long, 0.5 mm. wide. Petals obliquely elliptic, obtuse, 1.2–1.3 mm. long, 0.5 mm. wide. Lip concave, fleshy especially at apex, very obscurely 3-lobed at apex, elliptic-ovate, shortly apiculate, 1.7 mm. long, 1.3 mm. wide. Spur clavate, somewhat sigmoid, 1 mm. long. Column 0.4 mm. long; rostellum 3-lobed, with side lobes shortly produced above and below and mid-lobe deflexed and blunt
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: An epiphyte or rarely a lithophyte with a short pendent stem 1–4(–7) cm. long. Leaves falcate, oblanceolate to linear, unequally roundly bilobed at the apex, 6–20 cm. long, 1.4–2.1 cm. wide, twisted at the base to lie in one plane and articulated to imbricate leaf-sheaths, very dark green. Inflorescences 1–several, 7.5–20 cm. long, laxly 3–7-flowered; peduncle slender, 6–13 cm. long; bracts amplexicaul, conical, obtuse, 2–4 mm. long. Flowers white with the tip of the spur green; pedicel and ovary 2.2–3.1 cm. long. Dorsal sepal elliptic, obtuse, 2.7–3.3 mm. long, 1.6–1.8 mm. wide; lateral sepals spathulate, obtuse, 8.5–11.7 mm. long, 2–2.5 mm. wide. Petals obliquely triangular, acute, 3–3.3 mm. long, 3.8–4.6 mm. wide, joined to the lateral sepals for the basal 3–5 mm. Lip 3-lobed, 9–9.5 mm. long, 6.5–8 mm. wide; side lobes oblanceolate, somewhat bilobed or entire and rounded at the apex, 4–5 mm. long; mid-lobe lanceolate, acute, equal in length to the side lobes. Spur cylindrical, pendent, 5–6 mm. long from a broad mouth. Column 1 mm. long; rostellum 3-lobed; stipites 2; viscidia 2. Pl. 8.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: An erect epiphytic herb. Pseudobulbs cylindrical-fusiform or conical-ovoid, yellowish, with 3–5 nodes, 3–9 cm. long, 1–3 cm. broad, 4–6-leaved. Leaves narrowly elliptic, acute to acuminate, plicate, articulated at a persistent sheathing base, thin-textured; median and some secondary nerves prominent and hard, partially remaining as sharp, rigid thorns after lamina is shed; sheaths blackish brown along margins and at base, becoming scarious and fibrous, 2–3(–5) cm. long; lamina, including petiole, 20–40 cm. long, 1.5–3.5(–4) cm. broad. Inflorescence erect, paniculate, 15–50 cm. long, appearing from base of pseudobulbs; branches spreading, 3–22 cm. long, many-flowered; sterile bracts 3–4, remote, ovate-elliptic, obtuse to acute, amplexicaul, 1.5–4 cm. long; bracts subtending branches ovate-elliptic or narrowly elliptic, acute, 0.8–2.5 cm. long; fertile bracts triangular-ovate, acute, 0.1–0.3 cm. long. Flowers with sepals purple or brown on the outside, pale green inside, petals pale green or cream flushed purple or brown, lip with pale greenish yellow side lobes and deep yellow mid-lobe. Pedicel with ovary slender, 10–15 mm. long. Sepals spathulate-oblong, obtuse, 5–6.5 mm. long, 1.5–2 mm. broad. Petals elliptic, obtuse, 4–6 mm. long, 2.5–3 mm. broad. Lip 3-lobed, 5–6 mm. long, 3 mm. broad; mid-lobe retuse to bifid; side lobes oblong, obtuse, erect; disc with 2 fleshy keels. Spur cylindrical, obtuse, sharply bent forward, 3–4 mm. long. Column erect, oblong, biauriculate at base, 3 mm. long; anther ovate. Pl. 1. Fig. 89.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: A small epiphyte with a short bilaterally compressed stem, 5–7 cm. long, 1–2 mm. in diameter. Roots 0.5–1 mm. in diameter. Leaves slightly leathery, alternate, falcate, ligulate, unequally acutely bilobed at the apex, 2.5–5 cm. long, 0.6–1.1 cm. wide, somewhat shiny, twisted at the base. Inflorescences 1 per node, 1-flowered, ± 1 cm. long; peduncle 4–8 mm. long; bracts lanceolate, acute, 1–2 mm. long. Flowers white with a faint pinkish or greenish pink tinge; pedicel and ovary curved, 7 mm. long. Sepals lanceolate, acuminate, 8–8.5 mm. long, 3–3.6 mm. wide. Petals elliptic-lanceolate, acute or acuminate, 6.5–7 mm. long, 2 mm. wide. Lip concave, ovate, acute, 3–4.5 mm. long, 3.5 mm. wide. Spur conical-cylindrical, ± parallel to the ovary, 2.5–2.6 mm. long. Column 0.8–0.9 mm. long. Fig. 116.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: A dwarf epiphyte with very short stems 1–4 mm. long. Roots ± 1 mm. diameter. Leaves 2–4 in a fan, linear-ligulate, obtuse, 10–14 mm. long, 1.5–2.5 mm. wide. Inflorescences 4–10-flowered, 15–22 mm. long; peduncle 5 mm. long; bracts 0.5 mm. long. Flowers white; pedicel and ovary 1–2 mm. long. Sepals oblong-elliptic, rounded or obtuse, 1.3–1.4 mm. long, 0.7–0.8 mm. wide. Petals oblong or obovate, obtuse or rounded, 1.3–1.7 mm. long, 0.7–1.2 mm. wide. Lip very obscurely 3-lobed, broadly ovate or circular, obtuse, 1.2–1.5 mm. long, 0.9–1.3 mm. wide. Spur conical, rounded at the apex, 0.8–1.2 mm. long. Column very fleshy, 0.3 mm. long; stipes entire, very short. Fruit ellipsoidal, 4 mm. long.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: An epiphyte with 7–13 cm. long stems, 2 mm. in diameter. Roots all along the stem, 2 mm. in diameter. Leaves distichous, in upper half of the stem, coriaceous, ligulate, unequally roundly bilobed at the apex, 28–52 cm. long, 4.5–5.5 mm. wide, twisted at the base to lie in one plane. Inflorescences 1–3 per node, up to 2.5 cm. long, 1–2-flowered; peduncle 6–7 mm. long; bracts narrowly elliptic, acute, 2–3 mm. long. Flowers parchment green; pedicel and ovary twisted just below the flower. Sepals lanceolate, acuminate, 8.2–12 mm. long, 1.6–2 mm. wide. Petals lanceolate, acuminate, 9–10.5 mm. long, 1–1.2 mm. wide. Lip concave, ovate, acuminate, recurved at apex, 7–10.5 mm. long, 2.1–3 mm. wide. Spur filiform, rising above the ovary, ± straight to slightly sigmoid, slightly dilated at the apex, 16–20 mm. long. Column 1.5–2 mm. long; stipes short, bifid.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: A straggling epiphyte with a branching, slightly compressed stem, 4–60 cm. long, ± 3 mm. in diameter. Roots verrucose, 1–1.5 mm. in diameter. Leaves distichous, coriaceous, linear, unequally obtusely bilobed, 3.8–6 cm. long, 0.4–0.7 cm. wide, twisted at the base and articulated to verrucose leaf-sheaths, 5–8 mm. long. Inflorescences (1–)2-flowered; peduncle 2.5–2.7 cm. long; bracts triangular-ovate, acute, 1.5–5 mm. long. Flowers stellate, white; pedicel and ovary 18–20 mm. long. Sepals linear-lanceolate, acuminate, 17–31 mm. long, 2–4 mm. wide. Petals linear, long-acuminate, 21–31 mm. long, 1–3 mm. wide. Lip concave, ovate-subcircular, 9–11 mm. long, 10–11 mm. wide, with a 3.5–9 mm. long apicule. Spur decurved at the base, upcurved at the apex, slenderly cylindrical, 3.5–5 cm. long. Column 2–3 mm. long. Fruit 2–3 cm. long. Pl. 5.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: Shrub or small branched or unbranched tree 1–8(–18) m. tall with trunk up to 15 cm. wide; young shoots velvety tomentose; stems stout, pubescent, at length glabrescent, with obvious leaf scars, lenticellate; bark brown, slightly rough. Leaves crowded at the ends of the twigs; blades obovate, 5–32 cm. long, 3.5–22.2 cm. wide, rounded to obtuse at the apex, rounded to cordate at the base, glabrous or almost so above, glabrous to velvety pubescent beneath; petioles 0.5–3(–12) cm. long; stipules sheathing the terminal bud, broadly elliptic, 0.7–2.3 cm. long, soon falling. Flowers fragrant, in cymose pubescent to glabrous inflorescences from the upper axils; peduncles 0.4–19 cm. long, reddish at apex; secondary peduncles absent or 0.3–3 cm. long; pedicels mostly absent or very short. Calyx-tube green, tinged pink, campanulate, 1–3(–5) mm. long, adpressed pubescent; limb yellowish, 2–5 mm. long, undulate or with lobes 0–2 mm. long. Corolla white, cream or yellowish or greenish white, sometimes slightly pink tinged, adpressed silky pubescent outside; tube narrowly cylindrical, 2–4.6 cm. long; lobes 4–9(–11), oblong, 0.2–1.5 cm. long, 1.5–8(–10) mm. wide. Anthers the same number as the lobes, linear, subsessile in the throat, 3–5 mm. long, included. Ovary 4–9-locular; style slender, 1.8–4.5 cm. long; stigma green, obconic-cylindric, grooved, slightly bifid, reaching to or just beyond the anthers in long-styled flowers and to less than a half the way up the tube in short-styled flowers. Fruit green, streaked brownish red, ovoid or subglobose, 0.8–2.5 cm. long, 1.2–3.5(–4) cm. wide; putamen woody surrounded by cavities filled with pith-like tissue. Seeds 2–5 mm. long, 1.5–5 mm. wide, curved; radicle inferior; stony arilloid tissue present. Fig. 164.
bibliographicCitation: Rubiaceae, B. Verdcourt. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1976

description: A pendent epiphyte with an ancipitous stem, 4–15 cm. long, 3 mm. in diameter. Roots all along stem. Leaves in 2 ranks, falcate, ligulate, obtuse at the unequally bilobed apex, 2.2–6 cm. long, 8–9 mm. wide, yellow- to bronze-green, twisted at the base to lie in one plane. Inflorescences 1 per node, 1-flowered, 0.5–3.5 cm. long; peduncle 5–25 mm. long; bracts lanceolate, acute, 2–3 mm. long. Flowers stellate, pale ochre yellow to dull brownish green; pedicel and ovary 6.5–10 mm. long. Sepals linear-lanceolate, acuminate, 10.2–19.3 mm. long, 2.2–3.8 mm. wide. Petals linear-lanceolate, acuminate, 10.3–14.5 mm. long, 2–2.8 mm. wide. Lip recurved, ovate, acuminate, 8.5–12.5 mm. long, 4.5–6 mm. wide. Spur ± straight to slightly sigmoid, filiform, slightly dilated at the apex, 10.5–27 mm. long. Column 1.3–2.2 mm. long.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: A dwarf epiphyte with a very short stem, less than 5 mm. long. Roots terete, 0.5–1 mm. in diameter. Leaves twisted at the base to lie in one plane, arranged in a fan, distichous, linear-falcate, acuminate, 15–35 mm. long, 2.5–3.5 mm. wide, rather fleshy. Inflorescences arcuate, 20–45 mm. long, 5–15-flowered; pedicel very slender, 10–15 mm. long; bracts lanceolate, acute, ± 2 mm. long. Flowers pale to bright green; pedicel and ovary 2.5–4 mm. long; pedicel at an angle to the ovary. Dorsal sepal elliptic or obovate, subacute to obtuse, 1.7–2.3 mm. long, 0.8–1.1 mm. wide; lateral sepals obliquely elliptic-obovate, acute or subacute, 2–2.2 mm. long, 0.8–1 mm. wide. Petals elliptic, subacute or obtuse, 1.6–2 mm. long, 0.6–0.8 mm. wide. Lip entire, concave, ovate, obtuse, 1.5–2.1 mm. long, 1.2–1.4 mm. wide. Spur ± straight, clavate, 1.4–1.7 mm. long, straight and ± parallel to the ovary. Column 0.3 mm. long; rostellum-lobes upcurved hooks. Fig. 114, p. 496.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: A dwarf epiphyte often forming considerable clumps. Stems arcuate, slender, seldom branching, 3–25 cm. long; roots fine, 0.5 mm. in diameter. Leaves distichous, bilaterally compressed, curved-elliptic, obtuse in side view, 5–11 mm. long, 3–5 mm. wide, glossy dark green, deciduous, articulated to overlapping leaf-bases. Inflorescences opposite leaves, 1-flowered, 8–9 mm. long; bracts elliptic, obtuse, 1–1.5 mm. long. Flowers white; pedicel and ovary 5–6.5 mm. long. Sepals elliptic or oblong-elliptic, obtuse, 3.6–4.5 mm. long, 1.5–2 mm. wide. Petals oblong or oblong-elliptic, obtuse, 3.2–4.2 mm. long, 1.2–1.3 mm. wide. Lip concave, obscurely 3-lobed, obovate, obtuse, 2.9–3.5 mm. long, 2.8–4 mm. wide; side lobes rounded. Spur straight or slightly upcurved, tapering to an acute apex, 5.5–6 mm. long. Column 0.7 mm. long. Fruit 7–8 mm. long. Pl. 5.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: An erect epiphyte or lithophyte with a stem 1–4(–6.5) cm. long. Roots 1.5–2 mm. in diameter. Leaves 2–6, coriaceous, linear, unequally roundly bilobed at the apex, 5–26 cm. long, 0.4–1.6 cm. wide, articulated obliquely to the leaf-bases. Inflorescences many, suberect to arching, 8–25-flowered, 3–25 cm. long; peduncle 1.5–6 cm. long, rather stout, bearing spaced sheaths along its length; bracts amplexicaul, ovate, acuminate, 2–3 mm. long. Flowers pale greenish yellow, fleshy, faintly scented; pedicel and ovary 4–5 mm. long. Sepals elliptic-lanceolate or lanceolate, acute or acuminate, recurved, 5 mm. long, 1.3–1.5 mm. wide. Petals lanceolate, acuminate, recurved, 5 mm. long, 1–1.2 mm. wide. Lip concave, ovate, acuminate, 4 mm. long, 2.5 mm. wide, slightly recurved. Spur slightly upcurved beside ovary, subclavate, slightly dilated at the apex, 2.5–3 mm. long. Column 0.5 mm. long. Fruits 16–18 mm. long.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: A large robust epiphyte or lithophyte with an erect stem 60–100 cm. long, 1.5–2 cm. in diameter. Roots thick, fleshy, like boot-laces, 3.5–5 mm. in diameter. Leaves 6–10 or more, distichous, fleshy-coriaceous, obovate-ligulate, unequally roundly bilobed at the apex, 16–50(–70) cm. long, 2.9–7 cm. wide. Inflorescences suberect or ascending, 8–20-flowered, 30–75 cm. long; peduncle stout, 12–29 cm. long, bearing 1–3 well-spaced sheaths along length; bracts amplexicaul, broadly ovate, obtuse, 0.9–1.5 cm. long, dark brown. Flowers with a white lip, yellow-green at the mouth of the spur and with green sepals, petals and column, pleasantly scented at night; pedicel and ovary 16–18 mm. long, with the ovary twisted through 180°. Sepals reflexed, linear-lanceolate, acuminate, 3.3–4.5 cm. long, 5–7(–10) mm. wide. Petals linear-lanceolate, acuminate, 3.2–4.2(–4.5) cm. long, 5–7 mm. wide. Lip erect, transversely oblong to broadly ovate, (2–)2.4–3(–4.5) cm. long, 2.8–4.2 cm. wide, with a terminal apicule 5–7 mm. long; callus an entire ridge tapering from the base to the apex in the middle of the lip. Spur cylindrical, pendent, 4–5.8(–7) cm. long. Column fleshy, 5 mm. long, green.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: A scandent subepiphyte with ancipitous stems 20–40 cm. long and 3 mm. in diameter. Roots all along stem, 1.5 mm. in diameter. Leaves coriaceous, distichous, 2-ranked, linear-lanceolate, unequally acutely bilobed at the apex, 2.8–6 cm. long, 0.5–1.3 cm. wide, articulated to leaf-sheaths 2–3 cm. long. Inflorescences 1 per node, 1–2-flowered, 2.7–4.5 cm. long; peduncle 0.8–2 cm. long; bracts amplexicaul, ovate, 2 mm. long. Flowers light yellow-green or whitish green to pale salmon-pink, scented at night; pedicel and ovary curved strongly, 4–7 mm. long. Sepals lanceolate, acuminate, 11–14 mm. long, 2.5–4 mm. wide. Petals lanceolate, acuminate, 10–12 mm. long, 1.8–2.8 mm. wide. Lip lanceolate, acuminate, 8.5–10.5 mm. long, 3.3–4.6 mm. wide, with a linear raised callus in the basal part. Spur subsigmoid, filiform, (15–)18–28.5 mm. long. Column 1.5–1.7 mm. long. Pl. 5. Fig. 117, p. 502.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: An epiphyte with an elongate, bilaterally compressed stem 7–15 or more cm. long. Leaves distichous, oblanceolate or oblong, unequally roundly or obtusely bilobed at the apex, 9–11 cm. long, 1.6–2.3 cm. wide, twisted at the base. Inflorescences 7.5–11.5 cm. long, 3–5-flowered; peduncle 3–3.5 cm. long; rhachis slightly fractiflex; bracts broadly ovate, obtuse, 1.5–2 mm. long. Flowers yellow-green; pedicel and ovary 13–16 mm. long, articulated 1 mm. above the base of the pedicel. Dorsal sepal lanceolate, long-acuminate, 13.5–19 mm. long, 3.7–3.8 mm. wide; lateral sepals similar, 13.9–17.7 mm. long, 2.9–3.2 mm. wide. Petals lanceolate, acuminate, 11.5–13 mm. long, 2–2.5 mm. wide. Lip 3-lobed, 12–13 mm. long, 4.5–5.6 mm. wide; side lobes erect, rounded; mid-lobe recurved, linear, acuminate, 6.5 mm. long. Spur sigmoid, 14.5–16 mm. long. Column 1.3–2 mm. long.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: A terrestrial herb 1.5–3.5 dm. high. Tubers ovoid or ellipsoid, 1–2 cm. long, 0.7–1 cm. in diameter, ± densely tomentose. Stem erect, slender, with a single basal leaf, and a few scattered sheaths along its length, terete, ± densely pubescent. Leaf adpressed to the soil, broadly ovate to reniform-orbicular, cordate at the base, apiculate, 1.5–3.5 cm. long and broad, glabrous or with a very few scattered hairs on top, margins densely ciliate; sheaths on stem lanceolate, acute, 0.5–1.5 cm. long, pubescent. Inflorescence 2–7 cm. long, 2.5–3 cm. in diameter, rather closely 4–11-flowered; rhachis pubescent. Bracts lanceolate, acute, 5–9 mm. long, pubescent, shorter than the pedicel with ovary. Flowers erect, but facing outwards, not resupinate the lip being uppermost, pale yellow; pedicel with ovary slightly bent near the apex, 10–12 mm. long. Intermediate sepal ± at right angles to the ovary, convex, narrowly ovate, rounded, 6–7 mm. long, ± 4 mm. broad; laterals hardly spreading, obliquely oblong-lanceolate, obtuse, 7 mm. long, just over 3 mm. broad; all sepals densely pubescent. Petals 2-lobed in the apical third, 7–8 mm. long; lobe nearest the intermediate sepal triangular-ovate, rounded, ± 3 mm. long and nearly as broad, the other lobe smaller, linear, 1–2.5 mm. long but only 0.5–1 mm. broad. Lip bending upwards, 3-lobed in the apical half, ± 8–8.5 mm. long; lobes diverging, rather similar, the middle lobe a little broader than the side lobes, all ± 4 mm. long, the middle one 2 mm. broad. Spur curved upwards, club-shaped in the apical half or third, ± 1 cm. long. Anther ± 2.5 mm. high, canals incurved, ± 1 mm. long. Stigmas stout, much thickened at the apex, nearly 2 mm. long. Rostellum broadly triangular, obtuse.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: A terrestrial herb, 3–5 dm. high, glabrous except for the roots. Tubers ellipsoid or almost globose, 1.5–2.5 cm. long, 1–2 cm. in diameter, tomentose. Stem erect, slender to rather stout, with 2 (rarely 3) large leaves at the base and several much smaller ones scattered along its length. Basal leaves adpressed to the ground, opposite, broadly ovate to reniform-orbicular, obtuse or rounded, slightly cordate at the base, 5–7 cm. long, 5–8 cm. broad, fleshy; stem-leaves 4–6, ± erect, lanceolate or ovate-lanceolate, acute, up to 4 cm. long. Inflorescence 4–12 cm. long, 5–7 cm. in diameter, rather closely 3–15-flowered. Bracts like stem-leaves, 1.5–2.5 cm. long, the lower ones about equalling the pedicel with ovary. Flowers suberect, cream or whitish- or yellowish-green; ovary with pedicel nearly straight, 2–3 cm. long, the former usually with 6 toothed or crenulate wings. Dorsal sepal erect, lanceolate, acute, very convex, 1.3–1.6 cm. long, 6.5–8 mm. broad; laterals deflexed, obliquely semi-ovate, acuminate, 1.6–1.7 cm. long, ± 7 mm. broad; all sepals with 1–3 toothed keels on the veins outside. Petals bipartite nearly to the base; posterior (upper) lobe erect, linear, 1.3–1.5 cm. long, ± 1 mm. broad; anterior lobe curving upwards like a horn, subulate-linear, 2.5- 3.5 cm. long, 1–2 mm. broad near the base. Lip projecting forwards, tripartite nearly to the base; lobes linear, the middle lobe 1.8–2 cm. long, the side lobes 1.4–1.7 cm. long, all 1–2 mm. broad. Spur ± parallel to the ovary, somewhat swollen in the apical part, 2–2.5 cm. long. Anther erect, apiculate, 6–7 mm. high, canals porrect, rather slender, 6–8 mm. long. Stigmas porrect, slender below, suddenly widened and truncate at the apex, 7–9 mm. long. Rostellum triangular, acute, 1–3.5 mm. long.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: A terrestrial herb 2–9.5 dm. high, glabrous except for the roots and the petals. Tubers elongated ellipsoid or ovoid, 1.5–2.5 cm. long, scarcely 1 cm. in diameter, sparsely pilose. Stem erect, rather stout, rarely slender, leafy throughout its length. Leaves 9–13, the lowest 5–8 suberect or ± spreading, linear or lanceolate, acute, the largest 7–22 cm. long and 1–2 cm. broad, the upper ones ± adpressed to the stem, smaller, lanceolate, acuminate, resembling the lowest bracts. Inflorescence 4–25 cm. long, 3–5 cm. in diameter, rather densely 7- to many-flowered. Bracts lanceolate, acuminate, 1–3 cm. long, usually shorter than the ovary with pedicel. Flowers suberect, green and white; pedicel with ovary curved in the upper part, 2–3 cm. long. Dorsal sepal refiexed, narrowly elliptical, obtuse, convex, 6–9 mm. long, 2–4.5 mm. broad; laterals deflexed, obliquely obovate, apiculum lateral, 8.5–11 mm. long, 4.5–7 mm. broad. Petals bipartite nearly to the base, ciliate, pubescent in the lower part; lobes lanceolate, the posterior (upper) 5–7.5 mm. long, ± 1 mm. broad, the anterior spreading forwards, 8–12 mm. long, 1–2.5 mm. broad. Lip deflexed, tripartite from a very short undivided base ± 1 mm. long; lobes linear, middle lobe 10–17 mm. long, 0.5–1 mm. broad, side lobes 6.5–13 mm. long, a little broader than the middle lobe. Spur ± incurved, swollen in the apical half, 15–22 mm. long. Anther 2- 4 mm. high, the loculi reclinate, canals porrect or incurved, 4–7 mm. long. Stigmas porrect, suddenly swollen at the apices and truncate, 4.5–7.5 mm. long. Rostellum triangular-linear, acute, 1–2 mm. long.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: A terrestrial herb 3–8 dm. high, glabrous except for the roots. Tubers ovoid or nearly spherical, 1–2 cm. long, 0.8–2 cm. in diameter, densely tomentose. Stem erect, rather slender, leafy along nearly its whole length. Leaves 9–13, suberect or ± spreading, the lowermost 2–4 sheath-like, the middle ones lanceolate or oblanceolate, acuminate, the largest 7.5–13.5 cm. long and 1.5–3.5 cm. broad, the uppermost 2 or 3 smaller, lanceolate. Inflorescence 10–25 cm. long, 3–4.5 cm. in diameter, rather laxly many-flowered. Bracts lanceolate, acuminate, 1–2 cm. long, shorter than the flowers. Flowers spreading, often nearly horizontally, green or yellowish-green, fragrant; pedicel with ovary curved, 15–20 mm. long. Dorsal sepal erect, elliptical-ovate, rounded at apex, convex, 4.5–6 mm. long, 3–4 mm. broad; laterals deflexed, obliquely curved-lanceolate, subacute, 6–8 mm. long, 2.7–3.5 mm. broad. Petals bipartite nearly to the base; posterior (upper) lobe erect, ± adherent to the dorsal sepal, linear, curved, 4.5–5.5 mm. long, i 1 mm. broad; anterior lobe much narrower, curved upwards, 7.5–9.5 mm. long. Lip decurved, tripartite from an undivided base 1.5- 2 mm. long; middle lobe broadly linear, 5.5–8 mm. long and 1 mm. broad; side lobes linear, 7–10 mm. long, half as broad as the middle lobe. Spur ± parallel to ovary, only slightly swollen in the apical half, 17–22 mm. long. Anther ± 2 mm. high, rounded at apex, loculi parallel, ± reclinate, canals porrect, very short, ± 0.5 mm. long. Stigmas ± adpressed to base of lip, thinly club-shaped, 1.5–2.5 mm. long. Rostellum triangular, short and broad.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: A terrestrial herb 4–5 dm. high. Stem erect, leafy. Leaves lanceolate or elliptical-lanceolate, acuminate, up to 15 cm. long and 5.5 cm. broad, decreasing in size up the stem, the uppermost resembling the bracts. Inflorescence 10–20 cm. long, 3–5 cm. in diameter, rather densely many-flowered. Bracts lanceolate, acuminate, shorter than the flowers. Flowers suberect; pedicel with ovary 2–2.5 cm. long. Dorsal sepal erect, broadly lanceolate or almost ovate, very convex, apiculate, ± 11 mm. long and 8 mm. broad; laterals deflexed, obliquely oblong-lanceolate, acute, longer than the dorsal but only 5 mm. broad. Petals adherent to the dorsal sepal, wedge-shaped, curved, the outer margin much widened above the middle so as to appear almost 2-lobed, 10 mm. long, 5 mm. broad, ciliolate in upper half. Lip with ligulate undivided part 6 mm. long, deeply 3-lobed; middle lobe linear, 10 mm. long, 1 mm. broad; side lobes much longer, linear, 20–25 mm. long. Spur pendent, slightly swollen towards the apex, ±1.5 cm. long. Anther with a long apiculum, 5 mm. high, loculi parallel, canals erect, slender, 1.5 mm. long. Stigmas projecting, club-shaped, 2 mm. long. Rostellum middle lobe a little longer than the anther-loculi, truncate. Fig. 15, p. 72.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: Terrestrial herb 15–50 cm. high. Tubers not seen. Leaves 4–7, very unequal, 1–2 lowest ones sheath-like, 1–2 at base of stem lanceolate-oblong, acute, up to 13 cm. long and 2.5 cm. broad, the upper ones much smaller, similar to the bracts. Inflorescence slender, up to 16 cm. long, rather laxly up to 20-flowered. Bracts broadly lanceolate, acuminate, the lower ones, and often all, longer than the flowers. Flowers apparently in a single spiral row, suberect, green or yellowish-green; pedicel with ovary ± 1 cm. long. Dorsal sepal incurved, convex, 2.7–3.7 mm. long; laterals deflexed, obliquely broadly lanceolate, acute, 3–4 mm. long; all sepals ciliolate. Petals broadly lanceolate, back margin infolded, equalling the dorsal sepal and forming a helm with it. Lip 3-lobed nearly to the base, the claw 0.5–1 mm. long, total length 3.5–4.5 mm.; lobes narrowly oblong, the middle lobe longer and broader than the spreading side lobes. Spur pendent, slender, slightly swollen in the distal half, 10–16 mm. long. Column short; anther-loculi parallel, canals very short; stigmas club-shaped, 1–2 mm. long, rostellum middle lobe broadly rounded and hooded, equalling the anther.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: A terrestrial herb, 2.5–5 dm. high. Tubers ellipsoid or ovoid, 1.5–2 cm. long, ± 1 cm. in diameter. Stem slender with scattered leaves. Leaves 3–6, lowest sheath-like, remainder narrowly lanceolate or almost linear, shortly acuminate, up to 25 cm. long and 1.5 cm. broad, decreasing in size up the stem, the uppermost small, similar to the bracts. Inflorescence 4–11 cm. long, rather laxly up to 13-flowered. Bracts lanceolate, acuminate, shorter than the flowers. Flowers suberect, green, yellowish-green or greenish-white; pedicel with ovary 8–15 mm. long. Dorsal sepal ovate, ± acuminate, 4.5–7 mm. long; laterals spreading, very obliquely lanceolate or ovate, much curved, acuminate, 5.5–8.5 mm. long, a little broader than the dorsal. Petals obliquely ovate, the upper margins crenate, toothed or ± folded, 5–7.5 mm. long, the apical part thickened and opaque. Lip 9–15 mm. long, with a strap-shaped undivided part (claw) 2.5–6.5 mm. long, above this 3-lobed; middle lobe longer and broader than the divergent side lobes. Spur pendent, swollen towards the apex, 9–12 mm. long. Anther low with a distinct widened connective and separated sloping loculi, canals absent. Stigmas club-shaped, ± pointed, 2–3.5 mm. long. Rostellum middle lobe broad and rounded, the side lobes spreading, ± pointed, projecting beyond the anther for 1–1.5 mm.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: A terrestrial herb 1.5–9.5 dm. high. Tubers ellipsoid, almost globose or carrot-shaped, 1.5–3 cm. long, 0.5–2 cm. in diameter. Leaves 5–10, the lowest 2 sheath-like, the middle 3–5 lanceolate or oblong-lanceolate, acute, up to 30 cm. long and 3 cm. broad, the uppermost smaller but similar, bract-like. Inflorescence rather densely many-flowered, 5–50 cm. long. Bracts narrowly lanceolate, acuminate, the lower ones longer than the flowers. Flowers suberect with curved ovaries, green or yellowish-green with yellow anther; pedicel with ovary ± 1 cm. long. Dorsal sepal ovate or narrowly ovate, subacute, 2.5–4.5 mm. long; laterals obliquely and broadly oblong-lanceolate, obtuse, 3.5–5.5 mm. long. Petals very obliquely triangular-ovate, subacute, equalling the dorsal sepal but a little broader. Lip deflexed, 3–8 mm. long, 3-lobed from a short broad claw; lobes oblong or ligulate, obtuse, the side lobes a little longer than the middle one. Spur slender, ± incurved, 15–28 mm. long. Column short; anther-loculi parallel, horizontal, canals very short; stigmas club-shaped, truncate, 1–2 mm. long, rostellum middle lobe short, rounded and hooded.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: A terrestrial herb 3–7 dm. high, glabrous except for the roots. Tubers ovoid or ellipsoid, sessile or at the ends of slender roots, 1.5–3 cm. long, 1–1.5 cm. in diameter, ± tomentose. Stem erect, slender or rather stout, leafy in centre, the lower parts rather bare. Leaves 13–17, the lowermost 3–4 sheath-like, the middle ones oblanceolate or lanceolate, acute, the largest 10–15 cm. long and 2.5–5 cm. broad, the upper 2–4 much smaller, lanceolate, acuminate. Inflorescence 10–30 cm. long, 3.5–4.5 cm. in diameter, rather laxly many-flowered. Bracts lanceolate, acuminate, 8–16 mm. long, shorter than the flowers. Flowers spreading into a nearly horizontal position, green, sometimes tinged pink or brownish; pedicel with ovary bow-shaped, 16- 22 mm. long. Dorsal sepal reflexed, broadly elliptical-ovate or ovate, obtuse convex, 4–5 mm. long, ± 3 mm. broad; laterals deflexed, narrowly obliquely lanceolate, acute, 5–7 mm. long, ± 2 mm. broad. Petals bipartite nearly to the base; lobes reflexed or deflexed, linear or ligulate, about equal in length, the posterior a little broader, 4.5–6.5 mm. long. Lip deflexed, 3-lobed from a short undivided claw 1.5–2 mm. long; lobes linear, obtuse; middle lobe 4.5–6 mm. long; side lobes 3.5–5 mm. long. Spur ± incurved, somewhat swollen in the apical part, 15–27 mm. long. Anther 1–2 mm. high, loculi parallel, canals very short, less than 1 mm. long. Stigmas porrect or slightly decurved, club-shaped, 2–2.5 mm. long. Rostellum triangular, small.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: A terrestrial herb 4–5.5 dm. high, almost entirely glabrous. Tubers not seen. Stem erect, slender to rather stout, leafy throughout its length. Leaves 5–6 (lowest not seen), the middle 2–3 erect or suberect, linear, the largest 14–16 cm. long and 1–1.5 cm. broad, the upper ones smaller, lanceolate, acuminate. Inflorescence 10–30 cm. long, 3.5–4 cm. in diameter, rather densely many-flowered. Bracts lanceolate, acuminate, 1–2 cm. long, usually shorter than the pedicel with ovary. Flowers curving outwards, green with white petals; pedicel with ovary much curved, 1.5–2 cm. long. Dorsal sepal reflexed, narrowly elliptical, obtuse, ± 4.5 mm. long, scarcely 2 mm. broad; laterals deflexed, obliquely obovate with lateral apiculum, nearly 7 mm. long, 4 mm. broad. Petals bipartite nearly to the base; posterior (upper) lobe reflexed, linear, nearly 5 mm. long, 0.5 mm. broad; anterior lobe spreading forwards, triangular-lanceolate, acute, ± 10 mm. long, nearly 2 mm. broad at base. Lip deflexed, tripartite nearly to the base; middle lobe ± incurved, linear, ± 12 mm. long; side lobes oblanceolate-linear, acute, 9 mm. long; all lobes nearly 1 mm. broad. Spur curved strongly upwards, swollen in the apical third, ±1.8 cm. long. Anther 2.5 mm. high, loculi reclinate, canals incurved, 3 mm. long. Stigmas porrect, slightly thickened at apex, 3 mm. long. Rostellum elongate-triangular, nearly 2.5 mm. long.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: A terrestrial herb 3–4 dm. high, glabrous. Stem erect, somewhat flexuous, with a single leaf at the base and numerous sheaths along its length. Leaf adpressed to the ground, broadly ovate or reniform, 3–4 cm. long, 5 cm. broad; sheaths triangular, acuminate. Inflorescence 12 cm. long, loosely several-flowered. Bracts lanceolate, acuminate, scarcely as long as the pedicel. Flowers green; pedicel with ovary 2.5–3 cm. long. Dorsal sepal oblong-lanceolate, acute, convex, 4 mm. long, 3–4 mm. broad; laterals refiexed, ovate, obtuse, 5–6 mm. long, 3–4 mm. broad. Petals bipartite nearly to the base; posterior (upper) lobe erect, lanceolate, hidden beneath the dorsal sepal, 2–3 mm. long; anterior lobe curved upwards, linear-lanceolate, acute, 10 mm. long. Lip tripartite nearly to the base; lobes lanceolate, acute, equal, 7–8 mm. long. Spur incurved, narrow at base, swollen in apical part, 2 cm. long. Anther rather tall, canals arising from the middle of the column and rather long. Stigmas deflexed, surrounding the mouth of the spur.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: A terrestrial herb 1.5–5.5 dm. high. Tubers ovoid, 2 cm. long, 1.5 cm. in diameter, tomentose. Stem rather slender, loosely leafy. Leaves 4–7, the lowest 1 or 2 sheath-like, the remainder lanceolate or broadly lanceolate, shortly acuminate, the largest 6–12 cm. long, 2–3.5 cm. broad, the uppermost resembling the bracts. Inflorescence 5–10 cm. long, 2–6-flowered. Bracts lanceolate, acute, up to 5 cm. long, shorter than the flowers. Flowers curving outwards, green, the side lobes of the lip whitish, the column brown; pedicel with ovary 3–4 cm. long. Dorsal sepal erect, broadly elliptical, rounded, convex, 10–20 mm. long, 11–13.5 mm. broad; laterals spreading, obliquely lanceolate, subacute, 15–2 5 mm. long, ± 10 mm. broad. Petals obliquely oblong-elliptical, apiculate, 11–16 mm. long, 6.5–8 mm. broad, ciliolate on outer margin. Lip deflexed, 3-lobed just below the middle, the wedge-shaped claw ± 9 mm. long; middle lobe ligulate, obtuse, + 14 mm. long; side lobes 16–22 mm. long, divided on the outer margin into 3–8 threads which are up to 12 mm. long. Spur pendent, swollen in the apical half, 10–14 cm. long. Anther erect, 4.5–6.5 mm. long, the loculi adjacent, canals scarcely developed. Stigmas club-shaped, receptive surfaces obliquely truncate, ± 6 mm. long. Rostellum middle lobe very short and broad, the side lobes hollowed out at the apex.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: A prostrate puberulous or pubescent annual herb with branches up to 0.5 m. long. Petioles 1–7 mm. long; leaf-blade ovate-lanceolate to lanceolate, (1–)3–6.7 cm. long, (0.4–)1–1.8 cm. wide, subacute or obtuse, cuneate or rounded, closely and rather indistinctly serrate or crenate-serrate, firmly membranous, 3(–5)-nerved at the base, lateral nerves 6–8 pairs, sparingly pubescent above and beneath at first, later becoming glabrous except along the midrib and main nerves, green above, paler beneath. Stipules subulate, 1–2 mm. long, sparingly pubescent. Male racemes solitary, axillary, 4–5 cm. long, long-pedunculate, sometimes replaced by allomorphic ♀ flowers which give rise to a clavate, 1-seeded fruit; bracts 0.5 mm. long. Male flowers shortly pedicellate; buds subglobose, 4-gonous, to 0.3 mm. diameter, subglabrous, reddish tinged. Female inflorescences spicate, solitary, terminal or subterminal, cylindric, 2–4(–6) cm. long, ± 1 cm. wide, subsessile or shortly pedunculate; bracts multifid, the segments linear, (3–)4–5 mm. long, pubescent, eglandular, slightly reddish tinged, 1-flowered. Female flowers sessile; sepals 3, triangular, 1 mm. long, acute, ciliate; ovary deeply trilobate, 0.5 mm. diameter, sparingly pubescent at the apex, otherwise ± glabrous; styles free, slender, filiform, 7–8 mm. long, simple, glabrous, red. Fruits deeply trilobate, 1.5 mm. long, 2.5 mm. diameter, sparingly pubescent at the apex, otherwise glabrous. Seeds ovoid-subglobose, 1.3 mm. long, 1 mm. wide, smooth, brownish purple, with a small white velar caruncle perpendicular to the raphe.
bibliographicCitation: Euphorbiaceae, A. R.-Smith. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1987

description: A terrestrial herb 1.5–4.5 dm. high. Stem rather flexuous, with scattered leaves. Leaves 4–7, lowest 1 (or rarely 2) sheath-like, middle ones oblong- lanceolate or narrowly lanceolate, acute, up to 14 cm. long and 2.5 cm. broad, decreasing in size up the stem, uppermost bract-like. Inflorescence 5–11 cm. long, rather loosely 5–20-flowered. Bracts lanceolate, acuminate, the lower ones equalling or longer than the flowers. Flowers suberect, yellowish or green; pedicel with ovary 8–17 mm. long. Dorsal sepal inclined forwards, ovate or elliptical-ovate, obtuse, 7–8 mm. long, 4.5–6 mm. broad; laterals deflexed, obliquely lanceolate-ovate, subacute, about as long as but narrower than the dorsal; margins of sepals ciliolate. Petals obliquely ovate, sometimes with a small tooth on the outer margin, 7–8 mm. long, about as broad as the dorsal sepal. Lip 3-lobed in the upper half, 11–15 mm. long, the undivided part strap-shaped; lobes narrow, the side lobes longer and narrower than the middle lobe and diverging from it. Spur pendent, swollen in the apical half, 7–10 mm. long. Anther with a broad low curved connective and almost horizontal separated loculi, canals slender, projecting, 2–2.5 mm. long. Stigmas club-shaped, truncate, 2.5–3.5 mm. long. Rostellum middle lobe very broad, triangular, not very obvious.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: A terrestrial herb 2–3 dm. high, glabrous except for the roots. Tubers ellipsoid, ± 2.5 cm. long, 1–1.5 cm. in diameter, ± tomentose. Stem erect, rather slender, with a single leaf at the base and several leaf-like sheaths along its length. Leaf adpressed to the ground, reniform-orbicular, obtuse, cordate at the base, ± 5 cm. long and 7.5 cm. broad; sheaths lanceolate, acuminate, similar to the bracts, up to 3 cm. long. Inflorescences to 10 cm. long, ± 4 cm. in diameter, rather loosely 2–11-flowered. Bracts lanceolate, acuminate, 1–2 cm. long, the lower ones about equalling the pedicel with ovary. Flowers suberect; pedicel with ovary slightly curved, 1.5–2 cm. long. Dorsal sepal erect, lanceolate, acute, convex, nearly 1 cm. long and 5mm. broad; laterals deflexed, obliquely curved-lanceolate, acute, a little longer and narrower than the dorsal; all sepals with 3 toothed keels on the back. Petals bipartite nearly to the base; posterior (upper) lobe erect, linear, ± 7.5 mm. long and 0.5 mm. broad; anterior lobe curved upwards, linear, ± 12 mm. long, a little broader than the posterior. Lip ± upcurved or projecting forwards, tripartite nearly to the base; lobes linear, almost equal, ± 8 mm. long and 0.5 mm. broad. Spur pendent, the apical part swollen, ± 10 mm. long and 1 mm. in diameter. Anther 4 mm. high, canals slightly upcurved, ± 2.5 mm. long. Stigmas projecting forwards, slender below, much widened and truncate at the apex, nearly 4 mm. long. Rostellum acute, erect, just over 2 mm. long.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: A terrestrial herb 2–8 dm. high, glabrous except for the roots. Tubers ellipsoid, elongate-ovoid or nearly globose, 1.5–3.5 cm. long, 1–2 cm. in diameter, densely tomentose. Stem erect, slender to rather stout, leafy throughout its length. Leaves 9–15, the lowermost 1 or 2 reduced to sheaths, the middle 4–6 ± spreading or recurved, linear-lanceolate to ovate, acute, the largest 2–10 cm. long and 0.7–4.5 cm. broad, the upper ones smaller, adpressed to the stem, lanceolate, decreasing in size upwards, similar to the bracts. Inflorescence 5–19 cm. long, 3–6 cm. in diameter, loosely to densely 4- to many-flowered. Bracts leafy, lanceolate, acute, 1–2.7 cm. long, mostly shorter than the pedicel with ovary. Flowers suberect, pale green or yellow-green; pedicel with ovary almost straight, 1.8–2.8 cm. long. Dorsal sepal erect, very convex and almost boat-shaped, subacute, 5–16 mm. long, 4–8 mm. broad when flattened out; laterals deflexed, obliquely semi-orbicular, ± rolled up lengthwise, acute, 6–16 mm. long, 5.5–10.5 mm. broad. Petals bipartite nearly to the base; posterior (upper) lobe ± erect, usually adherent to the dorsal sepal, linear, 6.5–14.5 mm. long, ± 0.5 mm. broad; anterior lobe curling upwards like a long horn, linear below, subulate above, 2–4.5 cm. long, 1–2 mm. broad. Lip deflexed, tripartite from an undivided basal part ± 1 mm. long; middle lobe ± incurved in the apical part, linear, obtuse, 9.5–19 mm. long, ± 1 mm. broad; side lobes somewhat diverging, narrowly lanceolate or lanceolate-linear from a broad base, tapering in the apical part, often with 1 or 2 short teeth or shortly pectinate on the outer margin at about the middle, 8–18 mm. long, 1–2.5 mm. broad towards the base. Spur dependent, much swollen in the apical half or third, 1.4–2.7 cm. long. Anther erect, 3–7.5 mm. high, canals porrect or ± incurved, rather slender, 4.5–8.5 mm. long. Stigmas porrect, widened at the truncate apex, 3–8 mm. long. Rostellum triangular, acute, ± 1 mm. long. Fig. 20, p. 108.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: A terrestrial herb 3–8 dm. high, glabrous except for the roots. Tubers not seen; all roots appear to be long and slender, adpressed silky. Stem erect, slender, leafy throughout its length, rooting towards the base. Leaves 7–10, the lower 5–7 erect or suberect, linear or lanceolate-linear, acute, the largest 10–28 cm. long but only 7–12 mm. broad; upper ones smaller, lanceolate, adpressed to the stem. Inflorescence 7–16 cm. long, 3–4.5 cm. in diameter, rather loosely 9–30-flowered. Bracts lanceolate, acuminate, 8–15 mm. long, shorter than the pedicel with ovary. Flowers suberect or curved outwards, green; pedicel with ovary ± curved, 1.5–2 cm. long. Dorsal sepal erect or somewhat reflexed, narrowly elliptical, convex, 5–6 mm. long, 2–3 mm. broad; laterals deflexed, obliquely obovate, apiculum lateral, 7–8 mm. long, 4–5 mm. broad. Petals bipartite nearly to the base; posterior (upper) lobe erect, ± adherent to the dorsal sepal, linear, 5–6 mm. long, 0.3 mm. broad; anterior lobe horn-shaped, projecting forwards at first and then ± recurved, fleshy, linear below, ± subulate above, 12.5–15.5 mm. long, 1–1.5 mm. broad. Lip deflexed, tripartite from an undivided base just over 1 mm. long; middle lobe linear, ± incurved, the side lobes a little broader and more tapering, all lobes 11–14 mm. long, less than 1 mm. broad. Spur slightly incurved, swollen club-shaped in the apical half, 12–15 mm. long. Anther erect, ± 2.5 mm. high, canals horizontal with incurved apices, ± 5 mm. long. Stigmas porrect, slender with swollen truncate apices, as long as the canals. Rostellum triangular-linear, acute, ±1.5 mm. long.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: A terrestrial herb 1–4.5 dm. high. Tubers globose or ellipsoid, 1–3 cm. long, ± 1 cm. in diameter, somewhat woolly. Stem erect, leafy. Leaves 3–7, the lower 1 or 2 sheath-like, the remainder suberect or spreading, lanceolate or oblong-lanceolate, acute, the largest 5–12 cm. long, 1.5–4 cm. broad, decreasing in size up the stem. Inflorescence up to 15 cm. long, rather laxly 1–11-flowered. Bracts similar to upper leaves, lanceolate, acute, the lower ones overtopping the flowers. Flowers suberect, the sepals pale green, the petals and lip white; pedicel with ovary 2–2.5 cm. long. Dorsal sepal erect, elliptical-ovate, obtuse or subacute, very convex, 8–12 mm. long, 5–8 mm. broad; laterals spreading, obliquely ovate-lanceolate, acute, as long as but narrower than the dorsal. Petals erect, adherent to the dorsal sepal and forming a hood with it, obliquely semi-ovate or almost semi-orbicular, somewhat curved, 8.5–13 mm. long, 4.5–8 mm. broad, the outer margins ciliolate. Lip with a broad undivided basal part 3–5 mm. long, above this 3-lobed; middle lobe projecting forwards, narrowly or triangular lanceolate, 10–18 mm. long, 3.5–6 mm. broad at the base; side lobes divergent, often curving upwards, 16–22 mm. long, divided on the outer margin into 4–6 narrow threads. Spur pendent, swollen somewhat in the apical half, ± 3 cm. long. Column short, anther connective narrow, loculi a little divergent, canals very short; stigmas shortly club-shaped, truncate, 2–3 mm. long, rostellum middle lobe very short and broad.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: A terrestrial herb 1–4.5 dm. high, glabrous except for the roots and inner perianth members. Tubers ellipsoid, 1.5–2 cm. long, ± 1 cm. in diameter, closely tomentose. Stem erect, slender to rather stout, with 2 large leaves at the base and numerous much smaller ones along its length. Basal leaves adpressed to the ground, opposite, ovate to almost reniform, apiculate to rounded, usually somewhat cordate at the base, 2.5–4.5 cm. long, 3–6.5 cm. broad, rather fleshy; stem-leaves 7–25, lanceolate or linear-lanceolate, acuminate, ± adpressed to the stem, up to 2.5 cm. long. Inflorescence 4–18 cm. long, 2–2.5 cm. in diameter, very densely many-flowered. Bracts similar to the stem-leaves, lanceolate, 1–2.5 cm. long, the lower ones longer than the pedicel with ovary. Flowers suberect or curving outwards, green, yellow-green or yellow, fragrant; pedicel with ovary ± 1 cm. long. Dorsal sepal erect, ovate, acute, convex, 4–7 mm. long, 3–4 mm. broad; laterals spreading, very obliquely ovate or lanceolate, acuminate, 4.5–7.5 mm. long, ± 3 mm. broad. Petals bipartite from near the base, glabrous, shortly puberulous and/or ciliolate; posterior (upper) lobe erect, adherent to the dorsal sepal, curved, lanceolate-linear or narrowly lanceolate, acute, 3.5- 6 mm. long, 1–2 mm. broad; anterior lobe curved upwards, much smaller than the posterior, 1–4.5 mm. long, ± 0.5 mm. broad. Lip projecting forwards, 3-lobed from a short undivided base; middle lobe linear-ligulate or lanceolate-linear, subacute, 4–7.5 mm. long, just over 1 mm. broad, the side lobes divergent, shorter and narrower, 1.5–5 mm. long, 0.5 mm. broad, the lobes usually glabrous, rarely papillose or ciliolate. Spur dependent, with a rather thick base and swollen apical part, 8–13 mm. long. Anther erect, rounded or apiculate, ± 2 mm. high, canals horizontal, ± 1 mm. long. Stigmas porrect or slightly curved downwards, narrowly club-shaped, 2–3 mm. long. Rostellum broadly triangular, very short.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: A terrestrial herb 3–6.5 dm. high, glabrous except for the roots. Tubers ovoid or ellipsoid-fusiform, 2.5–5 cm. long, 1.5–2 cm. in diameter, tomentose. Stem erect, stout, terete, with 2 large leaves at the base and 6–11 smaller and narrower ones along its length. Basal leaves adpressed to the ground, opposite, suborbicular or transversely elliptical, apiculate or rounded, shortly sheathing at the base, 3–3.5 cm. long, 3–5.5 cm. broad; stem-leaves up to 4.5 cm. long and 2.5 cm. broad. Inflorescence 15–25 cm. long, loosely 2–4-flowered. Bracts similar to stem-leaves, 3.5 cm. long, shorter than pedicel with ovary. Flowers erect, pale olive-green and creamy-white; pedicel 3.5–6 cm. long, slender; ovary slightly curved, 2–3 cm. long. Dorsal sepal erect, concave, widely elliptical-lanceolate, acuminate, 2–2.8 cm. long, 8–13 mm. broad; laterals deflexed, obliquely semi-ovate, curved, acuminate, 2.5- 3.5 cm. long, 7–10 mm. broad; all sepals trinerved, the middle nerve bearing a scabrous keel on the outside, olive-green. Petals bipartite nearly to the base, pale cream or greenish-white; posterior (upper) lobe erect, almost erect or spreading, linear, acute, 2.5–3 cm. long, ± 2mm. broad, edges revolute; anterior lobe spreading, linear below, subulate above, 5–6.5 cm. long, 2 mm. wide at base. Lip tripartite almost to base; middle lobe hanging down, linear-ligulate from a wide triangular base, acute, 3 cm. long, 2 mm. broad in the middle, pale olive-green; lateral lobes strongly divergent, linear towards base, subulate towards apex, 4–5 cm. long, ± 2 mm. broad at base, creamy or whitish-green. Spur curving downwards among the stem-leaves, green, narrowly cylindrical, 15–25 cm. long, inflated to 3 mm. diameter at apex. Anther erect, 1.3–1.4 cm. high, obtusely apiculate, loculi parallel, arching upwards, 8 mm. long, auricles tongue-like, erect, 3 mm. long, yellow. Stigmatic arms stout, cylindrical, apex coiled, 11 mm. long. Middle lobe of rostellum large, placed against the anther and ± equalling it in length, broadly triangular, apex narrow, abruptly recurved, densely papillose, 1 cm. long, gradually merging into lateral lobes.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: Terrestrial herb up to 1.2 m. high. Tubers ellipsoid, up to 4 cm. long and 1.5 cm. in diameter, woolly. Stem erect, very leafy, up to 1 cm. in diameter at the base. Leaves 6–12, the lowest 2 sheathing, the remainder lanceolate or narrowly lanceolate, very acute, up to 35 cm. long and 3 cm. broad, decreasing in size up the stem. Inflorescence densely many-flowered, up to 56 cm. long, 1.5–2.5 cm. in diameter. Bracts lanceolate, acuminate, the lower ones longer than the flowers. Flowers suberect, green, sessile or nearly so; ovary 7–10 mm. long. Dorsal sepal elliptical-lanceolate or ovate, ± acute, 3.5–5.5 mm. long, very convex; lateral sepals spreading, obliquely lanceolate or oblong-lanceolate, equal to the dorsal. Petals obliquely broadly lanceolate, acute, a little shorter than the sepals but somewhat broader. Lip deflexed, 4–6 mm. long, 3-lobed from the middle, the basal undivided part wedge-shaped, the lobes narrow, the middle one longer and broader than the side lobes. Spur pendent, swollen in apical part, 5–6.5 mm. long. Column short; anther-loculi parallel, the canals very short; stigmas club-shaped, ± acute, 1–1.5 mm. long, rostellum middle lobe short, rounded.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: A terrestrial herb up to 1 m. in height. Tubers ellipsoid, 1–1.5 cm. long, 5 mm. in diameter; roots pubescent. Stem erect, rather stout, 1 cm. in diameter at the base, laxly leafy. Leaves ± 8, the lowest 1–2 sheath-like, the remainder suberect, lanceolate or broadly lanceolate, acuminate, the largest 9–15 cm. long, 3.5–5 cm. broad, decreasing in size up the stem, the uppermost like the bracts. Inflorescence ± 4-flowered, 10–18 cm. long, 7–12 cm. in diameter. Bracts leafy, narrowly lanceolate, acute, 6–9 cm. long, nearly as long as the flowers. Flowers spreading, the sepals green, the petals and lip white; pedicel with ovary 3.5–6 cm. long. Dorsal sepal erect, broadly lanceolate, 3.5–4 cm. long, 1.5–2 cm. broad; laterals spreading, obliquely lanceolate, slightly S-shaped, acute, 3.5–4.5 cm. long, narrower than the dorsal. Petals free, falcately semi-ovate from a narrow base, ± spirally twisted towards the apex, ± 4.5 cm. long and 1 cm. broad, shortly puberulous and ciliolate. Lip with a wedge-shaped undivided base 1.5–2 cm. long, deeply 3-lobed, altogether 4–5.5 cm. long and about as broad, puberulous; middle lobe broadly linear, obtuse, between 3 and 4 cm. long, ± 2 mm. broad; side lobes widely divergent, ± 3 cm. long, with ± 14 long slender threads 1–2 cm. long on the outer margins. Spur pendent, cylindrical, swollen in the apical third, 13–19 cm. long. Anther erect, 9–13 mm. high, the connective horseshoe-shaped, 11–14 mm. broad, loculi reclinate, canals slender, 11–12 mm. long. Stigmas with club-shaped apices, ± 2 cm. long, upper half free, receptive swollen surface 8–9 mm. long. Rostellum middle lobe broadly deltoid, 3–4 mm. high.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: A dwarf epiphyte with elongate, rarely branching stems 1–4 mm. long. Roots fine, 0.5 mm. in diameter. Leaves equitant, distichous, narrowly elliptic in side view, 6–7 mm. long, 2–3 mm. wide, light green. Inflorescences 2–4-flowered, 2–3 mm. long; peduncle very short, less than 1 mm. long; rhachis fractiflex; bracts ovate, subacute, 0.3–0.5 mm. long. Flowers greenish white; pedicel and ovary 3–4 mm. long. Sepals elliptic-oblong, obtuse, 1.4–1.7 mm. long, 0.7–0.8 mm. wide. Petals oblong-elliptic, obtuse, 1.3–1.4 mm. long, 0.7–0.8 mm. wide. Lip concave, ovate, acute, 1.6–1.7 mm. long, 1.3–1.5 mm. wide. Spur clavate, with a broad mouth, parallel to the ovary, 1.4–1.8 mm. long. Column 0.3–0.4 mm. long; anther-cap pointed.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: A terrestrial herb 1.5–5 dm. high. Tubers globose or ellipsoid, 1–2 cm. long, 5–12 mm. in diameter, ± woolly. Stem slender, with scattered leaves. Leaves 3–7(–9), nearly erect or recurved, 1 or 2 lowest sheath-like, white with dark reticulations, remainder lanceolate or elliptical-lanceolate, acute, the largest 3–11 cm. long and 7–18 mm. broad, the others decreasing in size up the stem. Inflorescence narrow, 5–19 cm. long, rather laxly up to 20-flowered. Bracts lanceolate, acuminate, shorter than the flowers. Flowers curved outwards, green; ovary 8–11 mm. long; pedicel 3–6 mm. long. Dorsal sepal elliptical or ovate-elliptical, obtuse, convex, 2.5–5.5 mm. long; laterals deflexed, obliquely semi-ovate, obtuse, 3.5–7 mm. long. Petals very obliquely or curved lanceolate, as long as the dorsal sepal and adherent to it. Lip divided almost to the base, 5–13 mm. long, the undivided part less than 1 mm. long; lobes linear, rather fleshy, ± incurved, the middle lobe a little longer and broader than the side lobes. Spur slender, slightly swollen towards the apex, 1.5–3 cm. long. Anther 2–3 mm. high, loculi parallel, canals scarcely 1 mm. long. Stigmas club-shaped, ± 1.5 mm. long, thickly papillose-pubescent on the lower surface. Middle lobe of rostellum narrow, acute, variable in length, median keel absent or very low.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: A terrestrial herb 3–5.5 dm. high, glabrous except for the roots. Tubers almost globose to elongate-ovoid, 2–2.5 cm. long, 0.5–2 cm. in diameter. Stem erect, rather slender to rather stout, with a pair of leaves at the base and a number of sheaths almost covering the whole length. Leaves ovate-lanceolate, ovate, oblong or orbicular, apiculate, sometimes slightly cordate at the base, 2.5–6 cm. long, 2–5 cm. broad; sheaths 5–8, ± adpressed, lanceolate, acute, 2–4.5 cm. long. Inflorescence 6–15 cm. long, ± 2.5–3 cm. in diameter, loosely or rather densely 5–12-flowered. Bracts similar to the sheaths, 1.5–3.5 cm. long, the lower ones often as long as the pedicel with ovary. Flowers suberect, white and green; pedicel with ovary slightly curved, 2–3 cm. long. Dorsal sepal erect, ovate, acute, convex, 6–8 mm. long, 5–6 mm. broad; laterals deflexed, obliquely semi-ovate, acute, 7–11 mm. long, 3.5–4.5 mm. broad. Petals bipartite nearly to the base; posterior (upper) lobe erect, hidden under the dorsal sepal, curved, lanceolate-ovate, acute, 5.5–7.5 mm. long, 3–4 mm. broad; anterior lobe spreading, cuneate-oblanceolate, obtuse, 6–5–10 mm. long, 2–3 mm. broad. Lip spreading downwards, tripartite from an undivided base 1–2 mm. long; middle lobe elliptical-oblanceolate, subacute, 7–10 mm. long, 2.5–4 mm. broad; side lobes slightly incurved, similar to the anterior petal-lobe, 5.5–9.5 mm. long, 1.5–4.5 mm. broad. Spur dependent, swollen in the apical half, 1–4.5 cm. long. Anther erect, apiculate, 4–5.5 mm. high, canals very short, scarcely 0.5 mm. long. Stigmas porrect, rather stout, club-shaped, 2–3 mm. long. Rostellum triangular-linear, acute, ± 1.75 mm. long.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: A terrestrial herb 2 dm. to 1 m. high, glabrous except for the roots and petals. Tubers ellipsoid to ovoid, 1–2.5 cm. long, 0.5–1 cm. in diameter, ± tomentose. Stem erect, slender to rather stout, leafy throughout its length. Leaves 7–11, the lowermost very rarely reduced to a sheath, the lowest 4–6 suberect or more often spreading, linear to lanceolate, acute, the largest 7–26 cm. long, 0.5–2(–2.5) cm. broad, the upper ones adpressed to the stem, often overlapping, much smaller, similar to the lowest bracts. Inflorescence 5–27 cm. long, 3.5–5.5 cm. in diameter, rather loosely 6- to many-flowered. Bracts lanceolate, acuminate, 8–25 mm. long, usually shorter than the pedicel with ovary. Flowers spreading, green with white petals and column; pedicel with ovary straight or somewhat bent, 1.5–2.5 cm. long. Dorsal sepal refiexed, narrowly elliptical, obtuse, convex, 5–7.5 mm. long, 2–3.5 mm. broad; laterals deflexed, obliquely obovate with lateral apiculum, 7–10 mm. long, 3.5–6 mm. broad. Petals bipartite nearly to the base; posterior (upper) lobe refiexed, linear or ligulate, 4.5–7.5 mm. long, ± 1mm. broad, papillose and ciliolate; anterior lobe spreading forwards, narrowly lanceolate, acute, 8–16 mm. long, a little broader than the posterior, glabrous or rarely papillose at the base. Lip deflexed, tripartite from an undivided basal part 2–3.5 mm. long; middle lobe linear, ± incurved, 9–13 mm. long, over 0.5 mm. broad; side lobes linear, 6–11.5 mm. long, a little narrower than the middle lobe. Spur with an incurved knee-shaped bend in the middle, twisted once or twice, much swollen in the apical half, 8–13 mm. long. Anther 2–3 mm. high, loculi reclinate, canals porrect or incurved, 4–6 mm. long. Stigmas porrect, suddenly swollen and truncate at apex, 5–7.5 mm. long. Rostellum triangular-linear, acute, ± 2 mm. long.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: A pendent epiphyte with bilaterally compressed, rarely branching stems, up to 60 cm. long, 4–7 mm. in diameter. Leaves distichous, narrowly elliptic-ligulate or oblanceolate, unequally obliquely roundly or obtusely bilobed at the apex, 11–21.5 cm. long, 1.5–3 cm. wide, twisted at the base and articulated to leaf-sheaths 2.2–5 cm. long. Inflorescences 1-flowered; peduncle 3–5.5 cm. long; bracts elliptic-ovate, obtuse, 6 mm. long. Flowers white, tinged with green on the spur, suffused with yellow inside lip, fragrant; pedicel and ovary 5.5–6.5 cm. long. Sepals linear-lanceolate, acuminate, 6–8.5 cm. long, 0.3–1 cm. wide. Petals linear, acuminate, slightly shorter than the sepals, 5.5–6 cm. long, 4–5 mm. wide. Lip concave, ovate-elliptic to oblong-ovate, 6.5–8.5 cm. long, 5–5.6 cm. wide, with a long apicule up to 12 mm. long. Spur funnel-shaped at the base, geniculate then cylindrical above, sigmoid, incurved or pendent, 16–21 cm. long, 1.5 cm. wide across base. Column fleshy, 5 mm. long. Fruit 5.5 cm. long. Pl. 5. Fig. 118, p. 503.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: A terrestrial herb 1.5–3.5 dm. high, glabrous except for the roots and petals. Tubers globose to ovoid or ellipsoid, 1–1.5 cm. long, 0.5–1 cm. in diameter. Stem erect, slender, leafy throughout its length. Leaves 5–8, the lowermost 1 or 2 reduced to sheaths, the remainder suberect or somewhat spreading, ovate-lanceolate to lanceolate, acute, decreasing in size up the stem, the largest 1.5–3.5 cm. long, 0.4–1 cm. broad, the uppermost similar to the bracts. Inflorescence 2–14 cm. long, 3.5–5 cm. in diameter, rather loosely 2–9-fiowered. Bracts lanceolate, acuminate, 1–2.5 cm. long, usually shorter than the pedicel with ovary. Flowers suberect or curving outwards, green with whitish centre; pedicel with ovary ± curved, 1.5–2.5 cm. long. Dorsal sepal erect, convex, elliptical, obtuse, 10–13 mm. long, 6–8 mm. broad; laterals spreading, adnate to the column and base of the lip, obliquely lanceolate or lanceolate-elliptical, subacute, 9–12.5 mm. long, 4–6 mm. broad. Petals erect, bifid in the upper part; basal undivided part ligulate, widened gradually upwards, 5–6 mm. long; posterior (upper) lobe erect, adherent to the dorsal sepal, lanceolate, subacute, 6–8.5 mm. long, ± 3 mm. broad, margins ciliolate; anterior lobe projecting above the dorsal sepal, linear, rather fleshy, 16–21 mm. long, scarcely 1 mm. broad, glabrous. Lip united in the lower part to the column; free part tripartite from an undivided base 3–5.5 mm. long; middle lobe ± deflexed, linear, 7–10 mm. long, 2 mm. broad; side lobes diverging forwards, narrowly linear, 13–16 mm. long, less than 1 mm. broad. Spur with base parallel to the ovary, then curved forwards and upwards into a complete loop, the apex projecting backwards, slightly swollen in the apical half, 2–3 cm. long. Column consisting of a low horseshoe-shaped connective ± 2 mm. high and 7–11 mm. long surrounding the mouth of the spur, the loculi at each end reclinate, 2–3 mm. long, the canals scarcely developed; stigmas porrect, rather stout, widened and truncate at the apex, 3–4 mm. long.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: A terrestrial herb 2.5–7.5 dm. high, glabrous except for the roots. Tubers ovoid, ellipsoid or elongate-conical, 1.5–3.5 cm. long, 1–1.5 cm. in diameter, sparsely tomentose. Stem erect, rather slender, leafy throughout its length. Leaves 5–10, the lowermost 1–2 reduced to sheaths, the middle ones suberect, ovate to lanceolate, acute, the largest 3.5–11 cm. long and 1.5–3.5 cm. broad, the upper ones smaller, lanceolate, acute, similar to the bracts. Inflorescence 3–14 cm. long, 5–8 cm. in diameter, rather loosely 2–9-flowered. Bracts leafy, broadly lanceolate to lanceolate, acuminate, 1–3.5 cm. long, distinctly shorter than the pedicel with ovary. Flowers suberect, white or cream-coloured, sometimes tinged green; pedicel with ovary rather slender, 4–6 cm. long. Dorsal sepal erect, broadly elliptical, obtuse, very convex, ± 1 cm. long and 6 mm. broad; laterals defiexed but spreading, obliquely semi-orbicular, subacute, 1–1.4 cm. long, 7–8.5 mm. broad. Petals bipartite nearly to the base; posterior (upper) lobe erect, adherent to the dorsal sepal, linear or ligulate, ± 1 cm. long, 1–2 mm. broad; anterior lobe curved upwards and outwards like a short horn, 1.3–1.7 cm. long, ± 2 mm. broad. Lip ± defiexed, tripartite from an undivided base ± 2 mm. long; middle lobe ligulate, obtuse, 1.2–1.8 cm. long, rather fleshy; side lobes diverging, narrowly lanceolate, acute, ± 1 cm. long; all lobes 1.5–3 mm. broad. Spur projecting forwards at the base and then recurved to form a knee-like bend, swollen near the apex, 5.5–6.5 cm. long. Anther erect, 4.5–6 mm. high, canals porrect or ± incurved, 2–3 mm. long. Stigmas thick, widened and truncate at the apex, channelled along the top, ± 6 mm. long. Rostellum triangular, acute, ± 3.5 mm. long.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: A terrestrial herb 3–5 dm. high, glabrous except for the roots and petals. Tubers globose, ± 1 cm. in diameter, densely tomentose. Stem erect, rather slender, leafy throughout its length. Leaves 8, the lowermost sometimes reduced to a sheath, the lower 4 or 5 suberect or almost erect, lanceolate-linear, acute, the largest 10–14 cm. long and ± 1 cm. broad, the upper leaves much smaller, adpressed to the stem, lanceolate, acuminate, similar to the lower bracts. Inflorescence 9–16 cm. long, ± 3.5 cm. in diameter, rather densely 12–24-fiowered. Bracts lanceolate, acuminate, thin in texture, 1.5–2.5 cm. long, the lower ones longer than the pedicel with ovary. Flowers suberect or curved outwards; pedicel with ovary curved, ± 2 cm. long. Dorsal sepal reflexed, narrowly elliptical, obtuse, convex, ± 6 mm. long and 2.5 mm. broad; laterals deflexed, obliquely semi-orbicular, the apex somewhat one-sided, ± 8 mm. long and 4.5 mm. broad. Petals bipartite nearly to the base; posterior (upper) lobe ± reflexed, linear, ciliolate, 5–6 mm. long, ± 0.5 mm. broad; anterior lobe spreading forwards, elongated lanceolate, curved, acute, 9–10 mm. long, just over 1 mm. broad, glabrous. Lip deflexed, tripartite nearly to the base; middle lobe linear, obtuse, 10–12 mm. long; side lobes lanceolate-linear, acute, 6.5–8.5 mm. long; all lobes ± 0.5 mm. broad. Spur parallel to the ovary, swollen in the apical half, ± 2 cm. long. Anther just over 2 mm. high, loculi reclinate, canals incurved, ± 3 mm. long. Stigmas porrect, widened and truncate at the apex, ± 4 mm. long. Rostellum triangular-linear, acute, nearly 2 mm. long.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: A terrestrial herb 3–7 dm. high, glabrous except for the roots. Tubers elongate-ovoid or ellipsoid, 2–4 cm. long, 1–1.5 cm. in diameter, densely tomentose. Stem erect, usually rather slender, leafy throughout its length. Leaves 7–12, the lowermost 1 or 2 reduced to sheaths, the remainder sub-erect, lanceolate to narrowly lanceolate, acute, the largest 7–12 cm. long and 1.5–3 cm. broad, the upper ones decreasing in size up the stem and similar to the bracts. Inflorescence 5–16 cm. long, 8–12 cm. in diameter, rather loosely 5–15(rarely –25)-flowered. Bracts leafy, lanceolate, acute, 1.5–5 cm. long, usually much shorter than the pedicel with ovary. Flowers spreading or somewhat curved upwards, white and pale green, fragrant; pedicel with ovary curved, very slender, 4.5–7 cm. long. Dorsal sepal erect, very convex, elliptical, shortly acuminate, 12–16 mm. long, 6–8 mm. broad; laterals deflexed, rolled up lengthwise, very obliquely obovate with the apex lateral, 14–20 mm. long, 10–14 mm. broad. Petals bipartite from a broad triangular papillose base 5–6 mm. long; posterior (upper) lobe filiform or very narrowly linear, 7–10 mm. long, scarcely 0.5 mm. broad; anterior lobe curving upwards like a horn, fleshy, tapering from a broad base up to 4 mm. broad, 2.5–3.5 cm. long. Lip projecting forwards, tripartite from a short undivided part ± 1 mm. long; middle lobe ± incurved, linear, 2.3–3 cm. long; side lobes similar but more pointed, tapering, 1.4–1.9 cm. long; all lobes ± 1mm. broad. Spur hanging or projecting outwards, slender but much swollen in the apical fifth or sixth, 4–7 cm. long. Anther erect, 5–6.5 mm. high, canals porrect with the apices upcurved, very slender, 1.4–1.9 cm. long. Stigmas porrect, very slender with abruptly swollen and truncate apices, 1.2–1.8 cm. long. Rostellum narrowly triangular, acute, ± 3 mm. long.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: A terrestrial herb 2.5–5.5 dm. high, glabrous except for the roots. Tubers ellipsoid or elongate-ovoid, 2.5–5 cm. long, 1.5–2 cm. in diameter, tomentose. Stem erect, slender to rather stout, with 2 large leaves at the base and several much smaller ones along its length. Basal leaves adpressed to the ground, broadly ovate to reniform-orbicular, rounded or obtuse at apex, sometimes somewhat cordate at base, 5–11 cm. long, 5–16 cm. broad, rather fleshy; cauline leaves 5–7, lanceolate, acuminate, up to 3 cm. long. Inflorescence 8–22 cm. long, 4.5–6.5 cm. in diameter, rather closely many-flowered. Bracts lanceolate, acuminate, 10–18 mm. long, thin in texture, shorter than the pedicel with ovary. Flowers spreading or half-spreading, white to greenish-cream; pedicel with ovary often slightly curved, 2–2.5 cm. long. Dorsal sepal erect, elliptical-lanceolate, acute, very convex, 9–12 mm. long, 4–6 mm. broad; laterals deflexed or refiexed, obliquely semi-ovate, acuminate, 10–14 mm. long, 4–5.5 mm. broad. Petals bipartite nearly to the base; posterior (upper) lobe erect, curved-lanceolate, acute, 9–12 mm. long, 1–2 mm. broad; anterior lobe projecting forwards or curving upwards, filiform, 2–3 cm. long, 0.5–1 mm. broad towards the base. Lip projecting forwards, tripartite nearly to the base; middle lobe linear, 8–15 mm. long, ± 1 mm. broad; side lobes narrowly linear to filiform, 2–2.5 cm. long, a little narrower than the middle lobe. Spur incurved in the middle to form a complete loop, narrowly cylindrical, a little swollen in the apical part, ± 3.5 cm. long. Anther erect, apiculate, ± 6 mm. high, canals upcurved in the apical half, nearly 4 mm. long. Stigmas porrect, club-shaped and truncate at the apex, slender near the base, ± 6 mm. long. Rostellum narrowly triangular, acute, nearly 4 mm. long.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: An epiphyte with elongate ancipitous stems up to 30 cm. long. Roots many, clustered, unbranched. Leaves subremote, equitant (conduplicate and overlapping), shaped like a scalpel, linear, acute, 3–5 cm. long, 2 mm. wide. Inflorescences much shorter than the leaves, 1–few-flowered; bracts minute, triangular. Flowers 1.8 cm. across. Sepals lanceolate, acuminate. Petals similar but narrower. Lip similar but a little shorter. Spur filiform, 4 times longer than the ovary, 15 cm. long. Column very short. Fruit 2 cm. long, 8 mm. in diameter.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968

description: A terrestrial herb 3–8 dm. high. Tubers globose, 5–10 mm. in diameter, woolly. Leaves 6–9, the 2 lowest sheath-like with dark reticulate markings on a white ground, the remainder linear or ligulate-linear, very acute, up to 16 cm. long and 1.2 cm. broad, decreasing in size up the stem, the uppermost bract-like. Inflorescence 7–30 cm. long, rather densely many-flowered. Bracts narrowly lanceolate, acuminate, the lower ones about equalling the ovaries. Flowers suberect with curved ovaries, green; pedicel with ovary ± 1 cm. long. Dorsal sepal elliptical or elliptical-ovate, obtuse, ± 3.5 mm. long; lateral sepals deflexed, obliquely semi-ovate, subacute, ± 5 mm. long. Petals forming a hood with the dorsal sepal and equalling it, ovate or oblong-ovate. Lip undivided, recurved, ligulate or lanceolate-ligulate, 6 mm. long, obtuse. Spur cylindrical, 10–12 mm. long, only slightly swollen. Anther erect, nearly 3 mm. high, loculi parallel, canals nearly 1.5 mm. long. Stigmas club-shaped or nearly fusiform, ± 2 mm. long. Rostellum middle lobe as tall as the anther, ligulate.
bibliographicCitation: Orchidaceae, V. S. Summerhayes. Flora of Tropical East Africa. 1968
